items.title: 早期股東要套現了！SpaceX逾9億股解禁 股價恐再承壓
items.title_en: Early Shareholders Set to Cash Out! Over 910 Million SpaceX Shares Unlock, Stock May Face Further Pressure
paras: SpaceX (SPCX-US) 上市後首批股票禁售期周四 (6 日) 屆滿，早期投資人將首度有機會出售部分持股。此次共有逾 9.11 億股取得交易資格，約占流通在外股份的 7%，規模甚至超過該公司首次公開募股 (IPO) 時發行的 6.39 億股，可能使已較 6 月中高點回落逾 50% 的股價承受進一步賣壓。
馬斯克旗下這家可重複使用火箭製造商 6 月登上那斯達克時，股價迅速升至 150 美元，數日後更突破 225 美元。不過，上市後 8 周走勢劇烈震盪，周三收在 108.27 美元低點。SpaceX 周二盤後公布上市以來首份財報，揭露資本支出超過營收兩倍，股價隨即重挫。
Rainmaker Securities 共同創辦人馬丁 (Greg Martin) 表示，相較於公司基本面或策略，禁售期解除可能更直接左右 SpaceX 股價短期走勢。
而且，後續還有更多股票可能陸續解禁。根據招股書，8 月 20 日另有 3.19 億股可能解除限制，9 月預計再釋出約 7 億股，10 月解禁規模也接近 7 億股，市場流通籌碼將持續增加。
不過，瑞穗分析師提醒，雖然潛在供給增幅相當可觀，但股票取得出售資格，並不代表整批持股都會立即流入市場。
馬斯克是 SpaceX 最大股東，持有超過 60 億股，但其持股禁售期要到 2027 年 6 月才會屆滿，因此不在本輪解禁範圍內。
亞特蘭大獵鷹隊安全衛貝茲 (Jessie Bates III) 則是準備套現的早期投資人之一。他 2022 年在 SpaceX 估值 1,270 億美元時投入約 15 萬美元；公司目前估值已達 1.43 兆美元，使其持股價值可能超過 150 萬美元。貝茲表示，計劃出售全部持股以鎖定獲利。
SpaceX 今年 2 月與馬斯克旗下 xAI 合併，合併後估值達 1.25 兆美元；上市前又同意以 600 億美元收購 AI 程式設計公司 Cursor，交易預計本季完成。市場除關注公司透過併購拓展成長機會，也將密切觀察首批解禁股票實際出售規模，是否加劇 SpaceX 上市後的股價跌勢。
paras_en: SpaceX (SPCX-US) saw its first batch of lock‑up shares expire on Thursday (the 6th), giving early investors their first chance to sell a portion of their holdings. More than 911 million shares are now eligible to trade, about 7% of the float, a volume that even exceeds the 639 million shares issued in the company’s IPO and could add further selling pressure to a stock that has already fallen more than 50% from its mid‑June peak.

When Musk’s reusable‑rocket maker debuted on Nasdaq in June, the share price quickly rose to $150 and a few days later broke $225. However, after eight weeks of volatile trading, it closed Wednesday at a low of $108.27. SpaceX posted its first earnings report after the listing on Tuesday after‑hours, revealing capital expenditures more than twice its revenue, which sent the stock sharply lower.
Greg Martin, co‑founder of Rainmaker Securities, said that the lock‑up expiration may have a more direct impact on SpaceX’s short‑term price movement than the company’s fundamentals or strategy.

Moreover, more shares are expected to unlock later. According to the prospectus, another 319 million shares could be released on August 20, about 700 million are slated for September, and the October unlock will be close to 700 million as well, continuously increasing the market float.
Mizuho analysts cautioned that while the potential supply increase is sizable, the fact that shares become eligible for sale does not mean the entire block will immediately hit the market.
Musk is SpaceX’s largest shareholder, holding over 6 billion shares, but his lock‑up does not expire until June 2027, so his holdings are not part of this round of unlocks.

Atlanta Falcons safety Jessie Bates III is one of the early investors preparing to cash out. He invested about $150,000 in 2022 when SpaceX was valued at $127 billion; the company is now valued at $1.43 trillion, making his stake potentially worth over $1.5 million. Bates said he plans to sell all his shares to lock in profits.

SpaceX merged with Musk’s xAI in February, bringing the combined valuation to $1.25 trillion; before the listing it also agreed to acquire AI‑coding firm Cursor for $60 billion, a deal expected to close this quarter. The market is watching not only how the merger expands growth opportunities but also the actual scale of the first unlock sales, to see if they will accelerate the post‑IPO price decline.

items.title: 說好讓Fed完全獨立！川普卻傳多次打電話給華許
items.title_en: Trump Has Been Calling Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh Despite Promising Independence
paras: 《彭博》周四 (6 日) 援引知情人士消息報導，美國總統川普自華許 (Kevin Warsh)5 月獲確認出任聯準會(Fed) 主席以來，已不定期與他多次通電話，成為川普試圖對央行發揮更大影響力的最新跡象。
其中一名知情人士表示，川普曾在通話中詢問華許對經濟的預測與看法，但未要求他採取特定行動。另有消息人士形容兩人並非定期聯絡，通話頻率也不高，目前尚不清楚雙方是否曾直接討論貨幣政策。相關通話最早由《華爾街日報》披露。
白宮發言人德賽 (Kush Desai) 表示，川普已多次強調，他會給予華許所需空間，以恢復外界對 Fed 決策能力的信心。川普雖有權表達對央行的看法，但也一再重申華許與 Fed 的獨立性。Fed 則拒絕置評。
過去美國總統與 Fed 主席也曾通話或會面，但情況相對少見。川普長期要求 Fed 大幅降息，其介入貨幣政策的程度，被視為數十年來白宮對央行最強力的施壓行動。不過，自華許上任後，川普對 Fed 的態度已較過去溫和。
華許上月在國會作證時表示，川普並未試圖干預央行，但他迴避直接回答上任後是否曾與川普通話。華許表示，不願公開自己與總統之間的談話內容，但承諾會維持獨立，且接到總統或參議院銀行委員會主席的電話並不會讓他感到不自在。
相較之下，前 Fed 主席鮑爾 2025 年 5 月與川普會面後，曾發布聲明向外界說明，並強調雙方未討論其貨幣政策展望。華許目前也定期與財政部長貝森特會面，延續 Fed 與財政部高層長期互動的慣例。
川普過去多次批評鮑爾降息「太慢」，其政府還針對 Fed 總部翻修工程對鮑爾展開調查。川普也曾試圖解職 Fed 理事庫克 (Lisa Cook)，但未能成功，據傳還考慮對理事巴爾(Michael Barr) 採取類似行動。
然而，川普公開對待華許的方式明顯不同。他在華許宣誓就職時表示，希望 Fed 主席「完全獨立」，並要他不要看任何人的臉色，只需按照自己的判斷做好工作。華許上任後決定維持利率不變，川普也未直接責怪他，而是將結果歸咎於一個被他批評為「非常政治化」的 Fed 理事會。
不過，川普持續對央行施壓，仍使 Fed 與行政部門之間的界線變得模糊，並可能影響市場對央行獨立性的信心。Fed 目前還須因應美伊戰爭造成的能源價格波動、川普反覆調整的關稅政策、揮之不去的通膨，以及龐大的美國預算赤字。
《華爾街日報》(WSJ) 指出，川普曾向華許詢問美伊戰爭對經濟的衝擊及 AI 崛起等議題，華許通常向川普描繪相對正面的經濟前景，但兩人是否談及利率政策仍不得而知。
paras_en: According to a Bloomberg report on Thursday, citing people familiar with the matter, US President Trump has been making periodic phone calls to Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh since his confirmation in May, in a sign of Trump's attempt to exert greater influence over the central bank.

One of the sources said that Trump had asked Warsh about his economic forecasts and views during the calls, but did not request him to take specific actions. Another source described the calls as not being on a regular basis and not frequent, and it is unclear whether the two have directly discussed monetary policy. The calls were first reported by The Wall Street Journal.

White House spokesman Kush Desai stated that Trump has repeatedly emphasized that he will give Warsh the space needed to restore confidence in the Fed's decision-making ability. Although Trump has the right to express his views on the central bank, he has also repeatedly reaffirmed Warsh's and the Fed's independence. The Fed declined to comment.

In the past, US presidents and Fed chairmen have also made phone calls or met, but such instances are relatively rare. Trump has long been pushing for the Fed to cut interest rates sharply, and his intervention in monetary policy is seen as the strongest pressure on the central bank from the White House in decades. However, since Warsh took office, Trump's attitude towards the Fed has been more moderate than in the past.

Warsh testified before Congress last month that Trump had not tried to interfere with the central bank, but he avoided directly answering whether he had spoken with Trump since taking office. Warsh stated that he did not want to disclose the content of his conversations with the president, but promised to maintain independence and would not feel uncomfortable receiving calls from the president or the chairman of the Senate Banking Committee.

In comparison, former Fed Chairman Powell issued a statement after meeting with Trump in May 2025, explaining the situation and emphasizing that they did not discuss monetary policy outlook. Warsh is also meeting regularly with Treasury Secretary Yellen, continuing the long-standing practice of interaction between the Fed and senior Treasury officials.

Trump has previously criticized Powell for cutting interest rates too slowly, and his administration even launched an investigation into the Fed's headquarters renovation project. Trump also tried to fire Fed Governor Lisa Cook but was unsuccessful, and reportedly considered taking similar action against Governor Michael Barr.

However, Trump's public treatment of Warsh has been noticeably different. When Warsh was sworn in, Trump stated that he hoped the Fed chairman would be 'completely independent' and told him to make decisions based on his own judgment, without considering anyone else's opinions. After Warsh decided to keep interest rates unchanged, Trump did not directly blame him, instead attributing the result to a Fed board that he criticized as 'very political'.

Nevertheless, Trump's continued pressure on the central bank has blurred the line between the Fed and the executive branch, potentially affecting market confidence in the central bank's independence. The Fed is currently facing challenges such as energy price fluctuations caused by the US-Iran war, Trump's fluctuating tariff policies, persistent inflation, and a large US budget deficit.

The Wall Street Journal reported that Trump had asked Warsh about the economic impact of the US-Iran war and the rise of AI, among other topics. Warsh typically presented a relatively positive economic outlook to Trump, but it is unclear whether the two discussed interest rate policies.

items.title: 〈美股早盤〉科技股走弱、油價推升殖利率 主要指數漲跌互見
paras: 美股主要指數周四 (6 日) 開盤漲跌互見，科技股賣壓拖累大盤，加上油價走高加劇通膨疑慮並推升美債殖利率，投資人在周五 (7 日) 關鍵非農就業報告出爐前轉趨謹慎。道瓊工業指數開盤走高，標普 500 指數在平盤附近震盪，那斯達克指數則開低。
威騰電子 (WDC-US) 與 SanDisk (SNDK-US) 雖繳出強勁財報及展望，仍未能滿足市場先前墊高的期待，股價雙雙重挫，進一步壓抑科技與記憶體類股。
市場同時密切關注中東局勢，伊朗與阿曼正推動重啟荷姆茲海峽航運的協議，但美伊能否達成更全面且持久的和平協議仍充滿不確定性。除地緣政治發展外，華爾街也正消化新一波企業財報，並等待就業數據提供 Fed 後續利率路徑的線索。
截稿前，道瓊工業指數漲近 260 點或近 0.5%，那斯達克綜合指數跌 220 點或 近 0.8%，標普 500 指數跌近 0.2%，費城半導體指數跌 1.4%。台積電 ADR 跌近 0.8%。
美股主要指數期貨周四漲跌互見，科技股走弱壓抑市場表現，投資人一方面等待美伊談判進展，另一方面觀望周五公布的美國非農就業報告，以尋找 Fed 未來利率政策的線索。
標普 500 指數期貨小漲 0.1%，那斯達克 100 指數期貨下跌 0.6%。記憶體大廠 SanDisk (SNDK-US) 與威騰電子 (WDC-US) 公布財報後，盤前分別重挫 9% 及 15%，儘管兩家公司業績與財測表現強勁，仍未能滿足市場先前墊高的期待。
Google 母公司 Alphabet (GOOGL-US) 由漲轉跌。該公司開始推銷最新一筆美國投資等級債券，外傳籌資規模最高可達 250 億美元。Alphabet 日前將 2026 年支出預測上調至最多 2,050 億美元，已引發投資人對 AI 巨額投入能否帶來足夠回報的疑慮，這次發債也將測試市場經歷 7 月 AI 債券拋售後的認購意願。
市場同時關注價值約 1,010 億美元的 SpaceX(SPCX-US) 股票周四解除交易限制。SpaceX 公布上市後首份季度財報後，股價一度重挫 14%，周四盤前則有所回升。
隨著科技股漲勢暫歇，投資人正重新評估 AI 概念股估值。周五非農就業報告預計將顯示美國勞動市場轉強，若數據高於預期，可能升高 Fed 升息預期；若數據疲弱，交易員則可能下修緊縮押注，減輕美債殖利率的上行壓力。
SEB 分析主管史坦納 (Karl Steiner) 表示，在中東局勢出現更明確的正面進展，以及美國重要就業數據公布前，市場目前採取觀望態度。《彭博》策略師孔寧 (Skylar Montgomery Koning) 指出，這份就業報告可能帶來兩極化反應，若連續第二次疲弱，將強化鴿派論點；若數據強勁，則意味 6 月表現可能只是異常，並使市場提前升息預期。
商品市場方面，布蘭特原油維持在每桶 80 美元附近。伊朗表示，已與阿曼就荷姆茲海峽航線提案達成協議，提高這條關鍵水道恢復能源運輸的可能性。不過，美伊仍未達成可持續緩解通膨與美債殖利率壓力的協議，美國總統川普周三僅表示，將觀察談判後續發展。
美元延續前一交易日跌勢，美國公債價格下滑，10 年期美債殖利率上升 3 個基點至 4.64%。黃金一度上漲 1.4%，短暫突破每盎司 4,300 美元。
歐股方面，道瓊歐洲 600 指數上漲 0.4%。德國電信宣布擴大庫藏股計畫後大漲 6.7%，英國酒商帝亞吉歐預測業務將恢復成長，股價上漲 7%；西門子因上調展望幅度未能滿足投資人期待，下跌 4.6%。
亞洲半導體股也成為賣壓重心，被視為 AI 交易風向球的南韓 Kospi 指數重挫 4.6%，SK 海力士與三星電子領跌。

items.title: 蘋果緊急搶購DRAM 距iPhone 18發表僅剩幾周
items.title_en: Apple Rushes to Secure DRAM Supply Ahead of iPhone 18 Launch
paras: 蘋果 (AAPL-US) 新機發表在即，記憶體供應鏈緊張局面進一步升級，知名分析師高燦鳴（Tim Culpan）5 日爆料，蘋果和供應商正在緊急搶購記憶體晶片。
距離備受期待的折疊 iPhone Ultra 以及 iPhone 18 和 iPhone 18 Pro 預計亮相的時間不到六周，蘋果組裝供應鏈正加快協調 DRAM。
目前蘋果高度美光供應 DRAM，但也向 SK 海力士和三星採購。但隨著 AI 資料中心需求持續擠佔記憶體資源，全球 DRAM 供應趨緊，蘋果也開始面臨過去較少遇到的供應壓力。
據韓國媒體《Digital Daily》5 日報導，蘋果曾試圖與長鑫存儲商談更低 DRAM 採購價格，但遭到拒絕。長鑫存儲堅持要求報價不低於三星電子和 SK 海力士，甚至更高。
原因在於，華為、小米等中國本土企業已透過長期合約鎖定長鑫存儲產能，因此長鑫存儲無需遷就蘋果的苛刻條件。
蘋果今年旗艦 iPhone 預計搭載首款採用台積電 N2 製程量產的 A20 Pro 晶片。
目前 A20 Pro 晶圓製造進展順利，良率表現也較為理想。但供應鏈消息顯示，大量已經完成製造的晶圓正在等待配套 DRAM 到位，無法順利進入後續封裝，封裝產能因此成為新機量產的關鍵限制因素。
高燦鳴指出，目前影響蘋果新機生產的核心問題，並非台積電先進製程產能不足，而是記憶體供應與先進封裝之間出現銜接壓力。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) is about to launch its new devices, and the memory supply chain is facing increased tension. Noted analyst Tim Culpan revealed on the 5th that Apple and its suppliers are urgently purchasing memory chips.

With less than six weeks to go before the highly anticipated foldable iPhone Ultra, iPhone 18, and iPhone 18 Pro are expected to debut, Apple's assembly supply chain is accelerating coordination for DRAM.

Currently, Apple primarily sources DRAM from Micron, but also purchases from SK Hynix and Samsung. However, as AI data center demand continues to occupy memory resources, the global DRAM supply is tightening, and Apple is facing supply pressure that it has rarely encountered in the past.

According to a report by Korean media outlet Digital Daily on the 5th, Apple attempted to negotiate a lower DRAM purchase price with CXMT, but was rejected. CXMT insisted on a quote that was not lower than Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix, and even higher.

The reason is that Chinese companies such as Huawei and Xiaomi have already locked in CXMT's production capacity through long-term contracts, so CXMT does not need to accommodate Apple's stringent conditions.
This year, Apple's flagship iPhone is expected to be equipped with the first A20 Pro chip produced using TSMC's N2 process.

Currently, the production of the A20 Pro wafer is proceeding smoothly, and the yield is relatively ideal. However, supply chain news indicates that a large number of wafers that have already been manufactured are waiting for matching DRAM to be in place and cannot proceed to the next packaging stage, making packaging capacity a key limiting factor for mass production of new devices.

Tim Culpan pointed out that the core issue currently affecting Apple's new device production is not the insufficient production capacity of TSMC's advanced process, but the connection pressure between memory supply and advanced packaging.

items.title: 兩樣情！外溢保單上半年狂銷488億元年增1.5倍 實物給付型保費腰斬
items.title_en: Two extremes! Excess insurance policies sell 488 billion yuan in the first half of the year, a 1.5-fold increase in sales, while material payment-type premiums are halved
paras: 金管會今 (6) 日公布最新統計，今年上半年外溢保單新契約保費收入為新台幣 488 億元，年增率高達 152%；反觀實物給付型保單，保費收入僅約 2.29 億元，大幅下滑 56%。對此，保險局主任秘書劉純斌說明，兩類商品表現兩極，主要與商品設計、民眾消費習慣及業者商品停售策略有關。
根據金管會統計，2026 年上半年外溢保單銷售件數達 74.59 萬件、年增 29%，初年度保費收入約 488 億元、年增 152%。前三大熱銷壽險公司依序為國泰人壽、南山人壽及富邦人壽。
劉純斌表示，外溢保單保費顯著成長的主因，在於部分熱銷商品屬於高保費類型，甚至有單件新契約初年度保費超過 100 萬元的商品；加上部分商品是在去年 6 月後才陸續推出，使今年同期的比較基期出現大幅成長。
從回饋機制來看，以「運動習慣折減保費或增加保額」最受歡迎，上半年保費收入高達 137.97 億元、年增 82%。劉純斌分析，主要回歸民眾的自主選擇，因為規律運動是保戶「自我可控」的健康管理方式。相比之下，「提供其他非現金給付 (如指定健檢服務)」保費收入則年減近 3 億元；主因在於許多選擇「體況數值折減保費」的保戶，本身已自費安排健檢，因此重複選擇非現金健檢服務的意願相對較低。
相較於外溢保單的大幅成長，實物給付型保單表現則相對疲軟。上半年新契約件數為 22.85 萬件、年減 5%，保費收入僅 2 億 2948 萬元、年減 56%。主要銷售前三名分別為國泰人壽、富邦人壽與南山人壽。
針對實物給付型保單顯著衰退，劉純斌解釋，主要因素為「主力熱銷商品停售」。受影響最深的為醫療服務類保單，雖然市場上商品件數有些微增減，但主要是一家壽險公司停售了 2 張先前銷量相對較好的醫療型商品。他進一步指出，儘管該商品在同類實物給付保單中銷售較好，但整體市場銷售規模仍未達公司預期目標，因而決定調整戰略停售。
此外，針對長期歸零的「健康管理服務型」實物給付保單，劉純斌坦言，這類商品市場需求與量能一直無法順利擴展。
談及實物給付型保單的發展困境，劉純斌補充，實物給付原本期望能深度結合長期照顧服務 (例如入住指定長照機構或相關照護服務)，但由於長照產業涉及嚴格的特許法規與政策限制，保險商品要完全無縫對接具備一定難度。此外，許多保戶偏好獲取現金給付後自行尋找合適服務，業者提供的限定服務不一定能完全符合每位保戶的個案需求。
paras_en: The Financial Supervisory Commission announced today (6) that the new contract premium income of excess insurance policies in the first half of the year was 488 billion yuan, with a year-on-year growth rate of 152%. On the other hand, the premium income of material payment-type insurance was approximately 229 million yuan, a significant decline of 56%. The Insurance Bureau's Director-General Liu Chunbin explained that the two types of products have shown two extremes, mainly due to product design, consumer habits, and the company's product stop-sale strategy.

According to the Financial Supervisory Commission's statistics, the sales volume of excess insurance policies in the first half of 2026 was 745,900, a year-on-year increase of 29%. The initial year premium income was approximately 488 billion yuan, a year-on-year increase of 152%. The top three best-selling life insurance companies in order are Cathay Life Insurance, Nan Shan Life Insurance, and Fubon Life Insurance.

Liu Chunbin pointed out that the significant growth in excess insurance premiums is mainly due to the fact that some best-selling products are high-premium types, with some products having a single contract initial year premium exceeding 10 million yuan. In addition, some products were launched in June last year and have been gradually introduced this year, resulting in a significant increase in sales compared to the same period last year.

From the perspective of the feedback mechanism, the most popular option is "reduction of premiums or increase of coverage based on exercise habits", with a premium income of 137.97 billion yuan, a year-on-year increase of 82%. Liu Chunbin analyzed that the main reason is that consumers have made their own choices, as regular exercise is a self-controlled health management method. In contrast, "providing other non-cash payments (such as designated medical services)" had a premium income of nearly 3 billion yuan less than last year, mainly because many consumers who have chosen "physical value reduction of premiums" have already self-arranged medical check-ups, and their willingness to choose non-cash medical services is relatively low.

In contrast to the significant growth of excess insurance policies, material payment-type insurance has shown a relatively weak performance. The sales volume of new contracts in the first half of the year was 228,500, a year-on-year decrease of 5%, with a premium income of 229,480 million yuan, a year-on-year decrease of 56%. The top three best-selling companies in order are Cathay Life Insurance, Fubon Life Insurance, and Nan Shan Life Insurance.

Regarding the significant decline in material payment-type insurance, Liu Chunbin explained that the main factor is "mainstream best-selling products have stopped selling". The most affected is the medical service type insurance, although the market has seen some minor fluctuations in product sales, the main reason is that one life insurance company has stopped selling two previously relatively popular medical-type products. He further pointed out that although the product has sold relatively well in the same type of material payment insurance, the overall market sales volume has not yet reached the company's expected target, and therefore decided to adjust the strategy and stop selling.

In addition, regarding the long-term zero-return "health management service type" material payment insurance, Liu Chunbin frankly admitted that the market demand and capacity have not been able to expand smoothly.

Regarding the development difficulties of material payment-type insurance, Liu Chunbin added that material payment insurance originally hoped to deeply integrate long-term care services (such as entering a designated long-term care institution or related care services), but due to the strict regulations and policy restrictions in the long-term care industry, it is difficult for insurance products to seamlessly connect. In addition, many policyholders prefer to receive cash payments and then find suitable services on their own, and the limited services provided by the company may not fully meet the individual needs of each policyholder.

items.title: 川習會還沒登場！中國密集反擊美國 這次不只做做樣子
paras: 中國本周密集推出新一輪對美反制措施，動用持續擴充的法律與監管工具，包括首度依據新修訂《對外貿易法》啟動國家安全調查、加強審查無人機相關出口、制裁 7 家美國實體，以及暫停與美方合作檢查輸中產品。北京在國家主席習近平預計下月訪美前展現反制能力，同時仍保留降溫空間，試圖警告華府不要進一步收緊對中科技限制。
美國 7 月 28 日限制部分外國製機器人與電力逆變器，這兩個領域均由中國企業占據主導地位。3 天後，美國國土安全部又以涉嫌使用強迫勞動為由，將 43 家中國企業列入黑名單。中國則在一周後連發 5 份聲明迅速反擊，反制速度與涵蓋範圍均顯示，北京已具備將貿易與科技爭端壓力快速升級的能力。

首度動用新《對外貿易法》 啟動國安調查

中國商務部宣布，對使用外國軟體的印表機、影印機及其他辦公影像設備展開國家安全調查。這是中國 3 月施行新修訂《對外貿易法》後，首度啟動相關調查機制。新法擴大中國政府回應外國制裁及其他限制措施的權力，也讓北京在未來的貿易摩擦中擁有更多政策工具。
中國網路安全主管機關隔日又宣布，基於保護關鍵基礎設施的需要，正式對美國資安公司 Palo Alto Networks(PANW-US) 在中國銷售的產品展開安全審查。官方僅發布簡短聲明，未明確說明此舉是否為對美反制措施，但宣布時機仍引發外界聯想。
中國也進一步收緊無人機相關產品的出口審查，並制裁 7 家美國實體。與過去多鎖定在中國幾乎沒有業務的美國軍工供應商不同，此次部分制裁直接指向協助美方執行限制措施的合規、溯源、盡職調查及稽核機構，影響可能深入跨國企業日常供應鏈管理。

制裁延伸至合規供應鏈 美企成本恐上升

包括 Applied DNA Sciences 與責任商業聯盟 (Responsible Business Alliance) 在內的 6 家實體，因涉嫌參與美國針對新疆強迫勞動問題限制中國企業而遭到制裁。北京另對亞利桑那州公司 Compliance Testing 採取措施，指控該公司協助美國聯邦通訊委員會 (FCC) 實施對中限制。
中國認證主管機關也決定，暫停授權設於美國的認證機構，為取得中國強制性產品認證 (CCC) 的產品進行後續工廠檢查。CCC 是指定商品在中國銷售前必須取得的安全與品質認證，無論產品是在中國境內製造或由海外進口，均須符合相關要求。
此舉意味美國製造商未來可能必須改由美國以外的合格機構進行後續檢查，不僅將增加成本，也可能造成認證及產品輸中時程延誤。
安可顧問 (Ankura China Advisors) 資深董事艾茲康 (Ryan Etzcorn) 表示，這輪反制將為跨國企業帶來實質的合規難題。中國正利用既有工具，直接反擊風險顧問與盡職調查服務商，讓反制措施從象徵性制裁延伸至各產業製造商的日常供應鏈合規作業。

川習會前控制火力 北京仍保留升級工具

儘管反制範圍擴大，北京似乎仍有意將行動控制在足以嚇阻美國、但不致破壞貿易休戰的程度。習近平預計 9 月底與美國總統川普會面，雙方在南韓峰會上達成的 1 年期協議則將於 11 月到期，除非兩國同意延長。
這項協議促使美中暫停部分關稅、稀土出口限制，以及針對中國造船業的調查。中國商務部發言人將最新反制形容為「總體克制」，並呼籲美方重返磋商，以協商方式解決分歧，但也警告，若華府再對中國施加新限制，北京不會猶豫採取更多措施。
歐亞集團 (Eurasia Group) 分析師 Dominic Chiu 等人在報告中指出，若川普政府採取更激進行動，例如限制中國開放權重 AI 模型，或禁止中國企業透過雲端服務取得晶片運算能力，將代表美國政策出現重大轉變，也可能使目前的貿易休戰面臨破裂。
雙方高層上周通話時，中國國務院副總理何立峰已對美國近期經貿限制表達「嚴重關切」；美國財政部長貝森特則要求北京全面履行承諾，包括確保稀土供應及採購美國農產品。
中國內部民族主義輿論則對北京的強硬回應表示歡迎。《環球時報》前總編輯胡錫進在微博發文稱，中國已不再只能被動承受美國打壓，反制工具也已準備就緒；若美國選擇升級雙邊貿易摩擦與科技出口管制，中國勢必奉陪到底。

items.title: 違約交割一次即圈存？金管會研議強化風控措施
items.title_en: Taiwan's Financial Supervisory Commission Considers Strengthening Risk Management Measures
paras: 台股今年火速衝破 3、4 萬點大關，成交量動輒破兆，違約交割金額與鉅額件數也不斷攀升，市場傳出，金管會將進一步強化投資人違約風險控管措施，未來若投資人發生違約交割，即便是首次違約且已補清差額結案，短期內下單買賣仍可能被要求實施「預收款券 (圈存)」。不過，證期局官員受訪時表示，目前尚處研議階段，並無上路時間表。
依據證交所 2021 年 10 月 12 日實施的現行規範，投資人首次發生違約時，僅由申報券商發函通知並進行法規宣導；若 1 年內再度發生第二次違約，全體券商才會自結案日起 3 個月內，針對該投資人實施連續 10 個營業日預收足額款券的限制。
然而，今年市場成交總量顯著擴大，媒體屢屢爆出少年股神案例，或是連 3000、5000 元也違約，顯見部分年輕人、小資族或新手投資人風險評估能力不足、流動性管理失效。
為進一步提升投資人風險意識並維護交割秩序，主管機關正研議縮短管制的「反應期」，預計將現行「二次違約才預收」的門檻往前推，未來只要發生一次違約交割，縱使後續在數日內繳清差額完成結案，在隨後的一定期間或指定交易次數內，下單時都必須預先備妥足額款項或股票才能交易，喪失了「T+2」延後扣款的便利性。
媒體質疑是否因近期小額違約或當沖違約爆量才緊急修訂，證期局官員澄清，今年市場成交量能大增，違約金額會隨基期放大，屬統計上的必然現象，證交所、櫃買中心違約專區每日均有公開數據供查閱。
官員強調，本次制度研議屬於例行性的市場秩序防護優化，包括券商管理、風控宣導等多個面向，都需要進一步檢討。相關機制目前仍處研議階段，具體參數設定與上路時程將待證交所正式提出方案後再行定案。
官員表示，未來槓桿資訊揭露專區 (台股儀表板) 將會上線，可望進一步提升市場資訊透明度，健全台股交易環境。
paras_en: Taiwan's stock market has seen a rapid surge in 2023, with trading volumes exceeding NT$10 trillion and violation settlement amounts and large-amount transactions increasing. The Financial Supervisory Commission (FSC) is considering strengthening risk management measures for investors, which may require investors who have violated settlement agreements to deposit funds or securities before making new trades, even if it's their first violation and they have already settled the difference.

According to the Taiwan Stock Exchange's current regulations, which were implemented on October 12, 2021, investors who violate settlement agreements for the first time will only receive a notification from their brokerage firm and a regulatory briefing. If they violate again within a year, all brokerage firms will impose a restriction on the investor for 10 consecutive trading days, requiring them to deposit the full amount of funds or securities before making new trades.

However, with the significant increase in trading volumes this year, there have been numerous cases of young investors or small-cap investors violating settlement agreements, even with amounts as low as NT$3,000 or NT$5,000. This highlights the inadequate risk assessment and liquidity management skills of some young investors.

To further enhance investor risk awareness and maintain settlement order, the FSC is considering shortening the 'reaction period' for the restriction. The current regulation requires a second violation before imposing the restriction, but the FSC plans to move the threshold forward, requiring investors to deposit funds or securities before making new trades even if it's their first violation, as long as they settle the difference within a certain period or specified trading frequency.

Media outlets have questioned whether the recent surge in small-amount violations or wash trading has led to the emergency revision of the regulations. However, FSC officials have clarified that the increase in trading volumes and violation amounts is a statistical inevitability, and the Taiwan Stock Exchange and Taiwan Futures Exchange have publicly disclosed data on violations.

FSC officials emphasized that the current regulatory review is a routine optimization of market order protection, including brokerage management, risk control guidance, and other aspects. The relevant mechanisms are still in the review stage, and specific parameters and implementation schedules will be determined after the Taiwan Stock Exchange formally submits a proposal.

FSC officials also stated that the margin information disclosure area (Taiwan Stock Exchange dashboard) will be launched in the future, aiming to further enhance market information transparency and improve the trading environment of the Taiwan Stock Exchange.

items.title: AI到底多燒錢？Google母公司Alphabet擬再發債最多250億美元
items.title_en: How Much Does AI Burn Money? Alphabet Plans to Issue Up to $25 Billion in Debt
paras: Google 母公司 Alphabet(GOOGL-US) 計劃透過最新一筆美國投資等級債券發行案，籌集最多 250 億美元資金。這筆交易將測試 AI 相關債券經歷 7 月拋售後，投資人的認購意願是否已經回溫。
外媒周四 (6 日) 援引知情人士消息報導，Alphabet 尚未對最終發行規模作出決定。此次債券最多分為 10 個券次，期限從 2 年至 40 年不等，其中最長天期債券的初步定價討論，殖利率較同年期美國公債高約 1.55 個百分點。
Alphabet 兩周前大幅上調 2026 年支出展望，再度引發市場質疑，科技巨頭投入 AI 的龐大資金最終能否轉化為相應報酬。該公司將 2026 年支出預測提高至最多 2,050 億美元，規模較 2025 年增加逾 1 倍，也使投資人對協助科技公司支應 AI 支出的債券需求在 7 月明顯降溫。
近期幾筆交易已顯示市場態度轉趨謹慎。與貝萊德 (BLK-US) 有關的公司上周發行 125 億美元債券，資金連結 Meta(META-US) 位於德州的資料中心計畫，但初期需求表現低迷；亞馬遜先前的發債案認購意願同樣疲弱。包括 SpaceX 在內的企業新發行 AI 相關債券，在次級市場的利差也持續擴大。
Alphabet 與亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 是本輪 AI 基礎設施舉債潮的主要推動者。Alphabet 在 2026 年上半年已發行超過 500 億美元債務，上一次進入美國高評級債券市場是在 2 月，此後陸續發行瑞士法郎、英鎊、歐元、加幣及日圓計價債券，兩個月前還發行近 850 億美元股票。
巨額資本支出已對 Alphabet 現金流造成壓力，使公司出現自 2004 年首次公開募股 (IPO) 以來，首度單季自由現金流轉負。此次最多 250 億美元的發債案，除了反映 Alphabet 持續投入 AI 基礎建設的龐大資金需求，也將成為市場檢驗投資人是否仍願意為科技巨頭 AI 擴張買單的重要指標。
paras_en: Alphabet, the parent company of Google (GOOGL-US), plans to issue up to $25 billion in debt through its latest investment-grade bond issuance, raising the most funds in the company's history. This transaction will test whether investors' appetite for AI-related bonds has recovered after a 7% decline in July.

According to sources, Alphabet has not yet made a decision on the final issuance size. This bond issue will be divided into up to 10 tranches, with maturities ranging from 2 to 40 years, including a preliminary discussion on the pricing of the longest-dated bond, which is expected to yield around 1.55% more than comparable US Treasuries.

Alphabet increased its 2026 expenditure forecast by a significant margin two weeks ago, sparking concerns about whether the massive investment in AI will ultimately generate corresponding returns. The company has raised its 2026 expenditure forecast to up to $205 billion, a more than 10-fold increase from 2025, which has led to a significant decline in demand for bonds that help finance AI expenditures in July.

Recent transactions have shown a cautious market attitude. A company related to BlackRock (BLK-US) issued $125 billion in bonds last week, linked to Meta's (META-US) data center project in Texas, but initial demand was sluggish; Amazon's (AMZN-US) previous debt issuance also saw weak demand. The spread of AI-related bonds in the secondary market has continued to widen, including those issued by SpaceX.

Alphabet and Amazon are the main drivers of the current AI infrastructure debt wave. Alphabet has already issued over $500 billion in debt in the first half of 2026, with its last entry into the US high-grade bond market in February, followed by the issuance of Swiss franc, pound, euro, Canadian dollar, and yen-denominated bonds. Two months ago, the company also issued nearly $850 billion in stock.

The massive capital expenditures have put pressure on Alphabet's cash flow, making it the first time since its initial public offering (IPO) in 2004 that the company has reported a negative free cash flow in a single quarter. The upcoming debt issuance of up to $25 billion will serve as an important indicator of whether investors are still willing to buy into the AI expansion of tech giants.

items.title: 兩樣情！外溢保單上半年狂銷488億元年增1.5倍 實物給付型保費腰斬
items.title_en: Two extremes! Excess insurance policies sell 488 billion yuan in the first half of the year, a 1.5-fold increase in sales, while material payment-type premiums are halved
paras: 金管會今 (6) 日公布最新統計，今年上半年外溢保單新契約保費收入為新台幣 488 億元，年增率高達 152%；反觀實物給付型保單，保費收入僅約 2.29 億元，大幅下滑 56%。對此，保險局主任秘書劉純斌說明，兩類商品表現兩極，主要與商品設計、民眾消費習慣及業者商品停售策略有關。
根據金管會統計，2026 年上半年外溢保單銷售件數達 74.59 萬件、年增 29%，初年度保費收入約 488 億元、年增 152%。前三大熱銷壽險公司依序為國泰人壽、南山人壽及富邦人壽。
劉純斌表示，外溢保單保費顯著成長的主因，在於部分熱銷商品屬於高保費類型，甚至有單件新契約初年度保費超過 100 萬元的商品；加上部分商品是在去年 6 月後才陸續推出，使今年同期的比較基期出現大幅成長。
從回饋機制來看，以「運動習慣折減保費或增加保額」最受歡迎，上半年保費收入高達 137.97 億元、年增 82%。劉純斌分析，主要回歸民眾的自主選擇，因為規律運動是保戶「自我可控」的健康管理方式。相比之下，「提供其他非現金給付 (如指定健檢服務)」保費收入則年減近 3 億元；主因在於許多選擇「體況數值折減保費」的保戶，本身已自費安排健檢，因此重複選擇非現金健檢服務的意願相對較低。
相較於外溢保單的大幅成長，實物給付型保單表現則相對疲軟。上半年新契約件數為 22.85 萬件、年減 5%，保費收入僅 2 億 2948 萬元、年減 56%。主要銷售前三名分別為國泰人壽、富邦人壽與南山人壽。
針對實物給付型保單顯著衰退，劉純斌解釋，主要因素為「主力熱銷商品停售」。受影響最深的為醫療服務類保單，雖然市場上商品件數有些微增減，但主要是一家壽險公司停售了 2 張先前銷量相對較好的醫療型商品。他進一步指出，儘管該商品在同類實物給付保單中銷售較好，但整體市場銷售規模仍未達公司預期目標，因而決定調整戰略停售。
此外，針對長期歸零的「健康管理服務型」實物給付保單，劉純斌坦言，這類商品市場需求與量能一直無法順利擴展。
談及實物給付型保單的發展困境，劉純斌補充，實物給付原本期望能深度結合長期照顧服務 (例如入住指定長照機構或相關照護服務)，但由於長照產業涉及嚴格的特許法規與政策限制，保險商品要完全無縫對接具備一定難度。此外，許多保戶偏好獲取現金給付後自行尋找合適服務，業者提供的限定服務不一定能完全符合每位保戶的個案需求。
paras_en: The Financial Supervisory Commission announced today (6) that the new contract premium income of excess insurance policies in the first half of the year was 488 billion yuan, with a year-on-year growth rate of 152%. On the other hand, the premium income of material payment-type insurance was approximately 229 million yuan, a significant decline of 56%. The Insurance Bureau's Director-General Liu Chunbin explained that the two types of products have shown two extremes, mainly due to product design, consumer habits, and the company's product stop-sale strategy.

According to the Financial Supervisory Commission's statistics, the sales volume of excess insurance policies in the first half of 2026 was 745,900, a year-on-year increase of 29%. The initial year premium income was approximately 488 billion yuan, a year-on-year increase of 152%. The top three best-selling life insurance companies in order are Cathay Life Insurance, Nan Shan Life Insurance, and Fubon Life Insurance.

Liu Chunbin pointed out that the significant growth in excess insurance premiums is mainly due to the fact that some best-selling products are high-premium types, with some products having a single contract initial year premium exceeding 10 million yuan. In addition, some products were launched in June last year and have been gradually introduced this year, resulting in a significant increase in sales compared to the same period last year.

From the perspective of the feedback mechanism, the most popular option is "reduction of premiums or increase of coverage based on exercise habits", with a premium income of 137.97 billion yuan, a year-on-year increase of 82%. Liu Chunbin analyzed that the main reason is that consumers have made their own choices, as regular exercise is a self-controlled health management method. In contrast, "providing other non-cash payments (such as designated medical services)" had a premium income of nearly 3 billion yuan less than last year, mainly because many consumers who have chosen "physical value reduction of premiums" have already self-arranged medical check-ups, and their willingness to choose non-cash medical services is relatively low.

In contrast to the significant growth of excess insurance policies, material payment-type insurance has shown a relatively weak performance. The sales volume of new contracts in the first half of the year was 228,500, a year-on-year decrease of 5%, with a premium income of 229,480 million yuan, a year-on-year decrease of 56%. The top three best-selling companies in order are Cathay Life Insurance, Fubon Life Insurance, and Nan Shan Life Insurance.

Regarding the significant decline in material payment-type insurance, Liu Chunbin explained that the main factor is "mainstream best-selling products have stopped selling". The most affected is the medical service type insurance, although the market has seen some minor fluctuations in product sales, the main reason is that one life insurance company has stopped selling two previously relatively popular medical-type products. He further pointed out that although the product has sold relatively well in the same type of material payment insurance, the overall market sales volume has not yet reached the company's expected target, and therefore decided to adjust the strategy and stop selling.

In addition, regarding the long-term zero-return "health management service type" material payment insurance, Liu Chunbin frankly admitted that the market demand and capacity have not been able to expand smoothly.

Regarding the development difficulties of material payment-type insurance, Liu Chunbin added that material payment insurance originally hoped to deeply integrate long-term care services (such as entering a designated long-term care institution or related care services), but due to the strict regulations and policy restrictions in the long-term care industry, it is difficult for insurance products to seamlessly connect. In addition, many policyholders prefer to receive cash payments and then find suitable services on their own, and the limited services provided by the company may not fully meet the individual needs of each policyholder.

items.title: 違約交割一次即圈存？金管會研議強化風控措施
items.title_en: Taiwan's Financial Supervisory Commission Considers Strengthening Risk Management Measures
paras: 台股今年火速衝破 3、4 萬點大關，成交量動輒破兆，違約交割金額與鉅額件數也不斷攀升，市場傳出，金管會將進一步強化投資人違約風險控管措施，未來若投資人發生違約交割，即便是首次違約且已補清差額結案，短期內下單買賣仍可能被要求實施「預收款券 (圈存)」。不過，證期局官員受訪時表示，目前尚處研議階段，並無上路時間表。
依據證交所 2021 年 10 月 12 日實施的現行規範，投資人首次發生違約時，僅由申報券商發函通知並進行法規宣導；若 1 年內再度發生第二次違約，全體券商才會自結案日起 3 個月內，針對該投資人實施連續 10 個營業日預收足額款券的限制。
然而，今年市場成交總量顯著擴大，媒體屢屢爆出少年股神案例，或是連 3000、5000 元也違約，顯見部分年輕人、小資族或新手投資人風險評估能力不足、流動性管理失效。
為進一步提升投資人風險意識並維護交割秩序，主管機關正研議縮短管制的「反應期」，預計將現行「二次違約才預收」的門檻往前推，未來只要發生一次違約交割，縱使後續在數日內繳清差額完成結案，在隨後的一定期間或指定交易次數內，下單時都必須預先備妥足額款項或股票才能交易，喪失了「T+2」延後扣款的便利性。
媒體質疑是否因近期小額違約或當沖違約爆量才緊急修訂，證期局官員澄清，今年市場成交量能大增，違約金額會隨基期放大，屬統計上的必然現象，證交所、櫃買中心違約專區每日均有公開數據供查閱。
官員強調，本次制度研議屬於例行性的市場秩序防護優化，包括券商管理、風控宣導等多個面向，都需要進一步檢討。相關機制目前仍處研議階段，具體參數設定與上路時程將待證交所正式提出方案後再行定案。
官員表示，未來槓桿資訊揭露專區 (台股儀表板) 將會上線，可望進一步提升市場資訊透明度，健全台股交易環境。
paras_en: Taiwan's stock market has seen a rapid surge in 2023, with trading volumes exceeding NT$10 trillion and violation settlement amounts and large-amount transactions increasing. The Financial Supervisory Commission (FSC) is considering strengthening risk management measures for investors, which may require investors who have violated settlement agreements to deposit funds or securities before making new trades, even if it's their first violation and they have already settled the difference.

According to the Taiwan Stock Exchange's current regulations, which were implemented on October 12, 2021, investors who violate settlement agreements for the first time will only receive a notification from their brokerage firm and a regulatory briefing. If they violate again within a year, all brokerage firms will impose a restriction on the investor for 10 consecutive trading days, requiring them to deposit the full amount of funds or securities before making new trades.

However, with the significant increase in trading volumes this year, there have been numerous cases of young investors or small-cap investors violating settlement agreements, even with amounts as low as NT$3,000 or NT$5,000. This highlights the inadequate risk assessment and liquidity management skills of some young investors.

To further enhance investor risk awareness and maintain settlement order, the FSC is considering shortening the 'reaction period' for the restriction. The current regulation requires a second violation before imposing the restriction, but the FSC plans to move the threshold forward, requiring investors to deposit funds or securities before making new trades even if it's their first violation, as long as they settle the difference within a certain period or specified trading frequency.

Media outlets have questioned whether the recent surge in small-amount violations or wash trading has led to the emergency revision of the regulations. However, FSC officials have clarified that the increase in trading volumes and violation amounts is a statistical inevitability, and the Taiwan Stock Exchange and Taiwan Futures Exchange have publicly disclosed data on violations.

FSC officials emphasized that the current regulatory review is a routine optimization of market order protection, including brokerage management, risk control guidance, and other aspects. The relevant mechanisms are still in the review stage, and specific parameters and implementation schedules will be determined after the Taiwan Stock Exchange formally submits a proposal.

FSC officials also stated that the margin information disclosure area (Taiwan Stock Exchange dashboard) will be launched in the future, aiming to further enhance market information transparency and improve the trading environment of the Taiwan Stock Exchange.

items.title: 快檢查家中暖手蛋！美急召回OCOOPA鋰電池過熱 7大問題型號一次看
items.title_en: Quick Check Your Home Hand Warmers! US Urgently Recalls OCOOPA Lithium Batteries Overheating – 7 Problem Models at a Glance
paras: 對近期媒體報導，知名暖手蛋品牌在美國因鋰電池過熱問題傳出商品召回事件，經濟部標準檢驗局今（6）日緊急於「商品安全資訊網」揭露相關資訊。該批受影響商品涵蓋 OCOOPA 廠牌旗下 UT3053、UT3056、ZLS-118、ZLS-118S、ZLS-118D、H01 及 H01(PD.) 等 7 款型號。標檢局已要求國內各大電商平台與代理商進行預防性下架，並呼籲民眾若家中持有上述型號，應立即停止使用。
標檢局表示，已同步通知國內代理商進行商品輸入狀況清查，若確認屬於美國召回範疇，將要求業者依法執行召回，相關訊息將陸續公布於「商品安全資訊網」。
因應隨身充電式電器普及帶來的安全隱患，標檢局指出，自 2023 年起已陸續將手持風扇、捲髮棒及暖手蛋等 14 項充電式電器納入應施檢驗範圍，規範業者必須完成檢驗程序方可輸入或出廠銷售。其中，暖手蛋已於 2025 年完成公告，並於 2026 年 7 月 1 日正式實施強制檢驗，重點檢測項目包括溫升、絕緣防護與構造檢查等電氣安規及電磁相容測試。
標檢局提醒，消費者選購隨身電器時應認明商品檢驗標識，詳細核對廠商名稱、電壓及型號等中文標示。使用時亦需遵循說明書規範，切勿在無人看管下充電、避免於潮濕環境使用，並防止產品重摔撞擊，以保障用電安全。
paras_en: In response to recent media reports, a well‑known hand‑warmer brand has been recalled in the United States due to overheating lithium batteries. The Ministry of Economic Affairs’ Bureau of Standards, Metrology and Inspection disclosed the details today (the 6th) on the “Product Safety Information Network.” The affected batch includes seven models under the OCOOPA brand: UT3053, UT3056, ZLS‑118, ZLS‑118S, ZLS‑118D, H01 and H01(PD.). The bureau has ordered major domestic e‑commerce platforms and distributors to proactively remove these items and urges anyone who owns any of these models at home to stop using them immediately.

The bureau said it has also notified domestic agents to audit the import status of the products. If a product is confirmed to fall within the U.S. recall scope, the seller will be required to carry out the recall in accordance with the law, and related information will be posted continuously on the “Product Safety Information Network.”

To address safety risks arising from the widespread use of portable rechargeable devices, the bureau noted that since 2023 it has gradually added 14 types of rechargeable appliances—including handheld fans, curling irons and hand warmers—to the mandatory inspection list. Manufacturers must complete the inspection procedures before the products can be imported or sold domestically. Hand warmers were announced for regulation in 2025, and compulsory inspections took effect on July 1, 2026, focusing on temperature rise, insulation protection, structural checks and electromagnetic compatibility tests.

The bureau reminds consumers to verify product inspection marks when purchasing portable electronics, checking the manufacturer’s name, voltage and model information in Chinese. Users should also follow the instruction manual, avoid charging the device unattended, keep it away from damp environments, and prevent heavy drops or impacts, in order to ensure electrical safety.

items.title: 八貫單月、前7月營收均創同期新高 受惠航太與軍工業積加溫雙助攻
items.title_en: Ba Guan's Monthly and Year-to-Date Revenue Hit New Highs, Boosted by Aerospace and Defense Industries
paras: 八貫 (1342-TW) 今 (6) 日公告 7 月營收為 3.38 億元，月增 9.6％、年增 76.9％，在航太與軍工產品業績加溫下，推升今 (2026) 年累計 1-7 月合併營收達 22.5 億元、年增 34.1％，7 月與前 7 月營收雙雙創下歷史同期新高。
八貫指出，7 月業績得力於航太航海與軍工兩大產品線客戶強勁拉貨與標案出貨貢獻，使航太航海 7 月業績較上月與去年同期分別大幅度提升 134％與 61％，軍工 7 月業績亦月增 2.1％、年增 109.3％，加上戶外與醫療 7 月業績分別年增 129％與 11％，在四大產品線業績火力全開下，7 月營收達年月雙增。
八貫表示，今年累計前 7 月合併營收達年增達 34.1％，主要是四大產品線前 7 月業績，較去 (2025) 年同期均為雙位數成長，其中戶外與醫療合計前 7 月營收比重達 78.68％，年增達 4.25 個百分點，為公司核心的兩大產品線，然航太航海與軍工前 7 月業績仍分別為年增 10％與 15％，成長動能不容小覷。
展望未來，八貫表示，據美國飛機製造商波音發布最新市場展望，全球航空市場長期成長趨勢未變，供應鏈需求穩健成長，整體市場發展前景仍具正向動能，八貫第 3 季產能稼動率已達滿載，第 4 季在手訂單明確，在終端市場需求穩健支撐下，公司將持續提升營運效率、優化產品組合，穩健朝 2026 年營運目標邁進。
八貫擁皮布料及成品組件兩個事業群，主要從事 TPU(熱可塑性聚氨酯彈性體) 機能性布料產品及其相關成品組件之 2 及 3 次製造加工及銷售，終端應用於高端醫療、航太、救生、戶外用等相關產業。
paras_en: Ba Guan (1342-TW) announced its July revenue as NT$338 million, up 9.6% month-over-month and 76.9% year-over-year. With the aerospace and defense industries heating up, the company's cumulative revenue for the first 7 months of 2026 reached NT$2.25 billion, representing a 34.1% year-over-year increase. Both July and year-to-date revenues hit new highs for the same period.

Ba Guan attributed its July performance to strong demand from customers in the aerospace and defense product lines, as well as the delivery of contracted orders. As a result, the company's aerospace and marine business saw a significant increase of 134% and 61% compared to the previous month and the same period last year, respectively. The defense business also grew 2.1% month-over-month and 109.3% year-over-year.

Ba Guan stated that its cumulative revenue for the first 7 months of 2026 grew 34.1% year-over-year, driven by the strong performance of its four major product lines. The outdoor and medical segments accounted for 78.68% of the company's revenue, with a year-over-year increase of 4.25 percentage points. Although the aerospace and defense segments grew at a slower pace, with year-over-year increases of 10% and 15%, respectively, their growth momentum should not be underestimated.

Looking ahead, Ba Guan cited the latest market outlook released by Boeing, which indicates that the long-term growth trend of the global aviation market remains unchanged, with stable growth in supply chain demand and a positive overall market outlook. With its production capacity utilization rate already at full capacity in the third quarter and a clear order book for the fourth quarter, the company will continue to improve its operating efficiency and optimize its product portfolio to achieve its 2026 operational targets.

Ba Guan has two business groups, focusing on the manufacture and sales of TPU (thermoplastic polyurethane elastomer) functional fabrics and related finished components. The company's products are used in high-end medical, aerospace, rescue, and outdoor applications, among other industries.

items.title: 〈台幣〉股匯不同調！連二升收32.261元 寫逾2周新高
items.title_en: Taiwan Dollar and Stocks Diverge! Rises Twice, Closes at 32.261, Hits Over Two‑Week High
paras: 外資昨 (5) 日大舉匯入並大買台股，今 (6) 日維持匯入操作，帶動新台幣兌美元一度升逾 1 角，不過，進口商伺機進場買匯，壓抑新台幣升幅，終場收在 32.261 元、升值 5.4 分，為逾 2 周新高，台北與元太外匯市場總成交值 31.385 億美元。
亞股今日普遍走低，台北股匯表現不同調，大盤一度下跌近 600 點，台積電、聯發科收黑，但台達電、鴻海等權值股強力撐盤，加上 PCB、記憶體族群獲買盤青睞，指數跌幅收斂，終場收在 44396.7 點，下跌 214.9 點。
新台幣兌美元今天以 32.29 元開盤，最高來到 32.2 元，為連續兩個交易日走揚，不過，午後匯市交易轉淡，美元買盤湧現，使得升幅收斂，終場收在 32.261 元，升值 5.4 分，為今年 7/20 以來的新高價。
觀察主要貨幣今天對美元表現，根據央行統計，美元指數小跌 0.07%，亞幣互有升貶，新台幣升值 0.17%，人民幣平盤整理，韓元則貶值 0.16%，日元貶值 0.09%，新加坡幣小貶 0.02%。
美國總統川普與多位美國官員紛紛表示，重新開放荷姆茲海峽 (Strait of Hormuz) 的重要協議已接近完成，近日油價應聲重挫，美元指數也跌破 100 大關。
paras_en: Foreign investors made a large net purchase of Taiwanese stocks yesterday (the 5th) and continued net buying today (the 6th), prompting the New Taiwan dollar to briefly rise more than 0.1 NTD against the US dollar. However, importers seized the opportunity to buy foreign currency, curbing the dollar's gains. It closed at 32.261 NTD, up 0.054 NTD, a more‑than‑two‑week high, with total turnover in the Taipei and Yuan‑Tai foreign‑exchange markets reaching US$3.1385 billion.

Asian equities fell across the board today, but the Taipei market moved in the opposite direction. The main index slipped nearly 600 points, with TSMC and MediaTek ending lower, while heavyweight stocks such as Delta Electronics and Foxconn provided strong support. PCB and memory stocks also attracted buying, narrowing the index’s decline. It closed at 44,396.7 points, down 214.9 points.

The New Taiwan dollar opened at 32.29 NTD per US dollar and peaked at 32.20 NTD, marking a second consecutive day of appreciation. In the afternoon, foreign‑exchange trading cooled and buying pressure on the dollar intensified, trimming the gains. The currency settled at 32.261 NTD, up 0.054 NTD, its highest level since July 20 of this year.

Looking at major currencies against the US dollar, central‑bank data show the dollar index slipped 0.07%. Asian currencies were mixed: the New Taiwan dollar rose 0.17%, the Chinese yuan was flat, the Korean won fell 0.16%, the Japanese yen fell 0.09%, and the Singapore dollar slipped 0.02%.

U.S. President Donald Trump and several U.S. officials said that an important agreement to reopen the Strait of Hormuz is close to completion. Oil prices have sharply fallen as a result, and the dollar index has slipped below the 100‑point threshold.

items.title: 外資買超縮至20億元 大買力積電、群創各逾3.7萬張 出脫金融股
items.title_en: Foreign Capital Net Buying Shrinks to NT$2 Billion, Buying Power Accumulates in Powerchip and Unimicron
paras: 台股今 (6) 日受大型電子股走弱影響，加權指數收 44,396.7 點，下跌 214.9 點或 0.48％，總成交量縮減為 9,694.7 億元，統計今日三大法人合計買超 45.6 億元。其中外資買超由前一交易日的 903 億元縮減至 20 億元，元大台灣 50 反 1(00632R-TW) 及力積電 (6770-TW) 為單日外資買超前 2 名。
統計今日三大法人動向部分，外資買超 20.2 億元，投信買超 88.56 億元，自營商則賣超 63.1 億元，三大法人合計買超 45.6 億元。在期貨籌碼部分，外資在期貨淨空單部分，增加 2,121 口達 8.93 萬口，逼近 9 萬口歷史新高。
外資買超前 10 名中，以買超 4.6 萬張元大台灣 50 反 1 最高居首，買超 3.86 力積電居次，買群創 3.77 萬張居第三位，買主動式 ETF 主動統一升級 50(00403A-TW)3.67 萬張、鴻海 2.17 萬張，中鋼 1.62 萬張、遠東新 1.44 萬張、聯電 1.44 萬張、台泥 1.43 萬張。
外資賣超前 10 名中，共 6 檔為金融股，買超首位為臺企銀 2.33 萬張居冠、其次為第一金 2.16 萬張、台中銀 2.09 萬張、凱基金 1.97 萬張、主動統一全球創新 (00988A-TW)1.85 萬張、中纖 1.82 萬張、群益台灣精選高息 (00919-TW)1.75 萬張、兆豐金 1.61 萬張、台新新光金 1.59 萬張。也賣超台積電 4,011 張。
投信買超前 10 名中，前 3 名皆為金融股，大買華南金 1.04 萬張居冠、兆豐金 7,520 張、第一金 7,361 張、元大台灣 50(0050-TW)5,800 張、旺宏 5,080 張、凱基金 4,112 張、臻鼎 - KY2,715 張、景碩 2,051 張、主動野村臺灣優選 00980A 張、華通 2,020 張。
投信賣超前 10 名，也有 6 名為金融股，以聯電賣超 6,458 張最多、富邦金 3,184 張居次、永豐金 1,879 張、元大金 1,821 張、上海商銀 1,395 張、台新新光金 1,311 張、南亞 1,205 張，中華、統一及彰銀。
法人表示，台股短線盤勢延續權值股整理、題材股輪動的結構，指數盤中跌破季線後收復，所幸收盤仍高於所有均線之上，觀察 4,4000 點附近，為近期支撐觀察位置，上方 44,600 至 45,000 點反壓仍在，指數若要進一步轉強，仍須觀察台積電、聯發科能否止穩，及櫃買市場的強勢能否延續。
法人指出，今晚美國初領失業金與周五 (8 月 7 日) 非農將接續檢驗 ADP 就業人口數，在數據公布前，仍須留意高檔波動放大的風險。
paras_en: The Taiwan Stock Exchange (TWSE) fell 214.9 points or 0.48% to 44,396.7 points today, with a total trading volume of NT$96.94 billion, down from NT$97.49 billion yesterday. The net buying by foreign investors decreased to NT$2 billion from NT$90.3 billion yesterday, with Meta Taiwan 50 (00632R-TW) and Powerchip (6770-TW) ranking first and second in net buying.

The net buying by foreign investors was NT$20.2 billion, while the net buying by institutional investors was NT$88.56 billion, and the net selling by individual investors was NT$63.1 billion, resulting in a net buying of NT$45.6 billion by the three major investors. In the futures market, foreign investors increased their net short positions to 89,300 contracts, close to the historical high of 90,000 contracts.

Among the top 10 net buyers, Meta Taiwan 50 (00632R-TW) had the highest net buying of NT$46,000, followed by Powerchip (6770-TW) with NT$38.6 million, and Unimicron (2303-TW) with NT$37.7 million. Other notable net buyers included Actively Managed ETF - Actively Managed Unified Upgrade 50 (00403A-TW) with NT$36.7 million, Foxconn (2354-TW) with NT$21.7 million, Taiwan Steel (2002-TW) with NT$16.2 million, Evergreen Marine (1902-TW) with NT$14.4 million, and United Microelectronics (2303-TW) with NT$14.4 million.

Among the top 10 net sellers, six were financial stocks, with Taiwan Enterprise Bank (1055-TW) ranking first with NT$23.3 million, followed by First Financial Holding (2884-TW) with NT$21.6 million, Taichung Bank (5880-TW) with NT$20.9 million, KGI Securities (2881-TW) with NT$19.7 million, Actively Managed Unified Global Innovation (00988A-TW) with NT$18.5 million, and Taiwan Fiber Optics (1821-TW) with NT$18.2 million. Powerchip (6754-TW) also had a net selling of NT$4,011.

Among the top 10 net buyers by institutional investors, the top three were all financial stocks, with China Development Financial (2020-TW) ranking first with NT$10.4 million, Fubon Financial (2881-TW) with NT$7,520, First Financial Holding (2884-TW) with NT$7,361, Meta Taiwan 50 (0050-TW) with NT$5,800, and Wantai (2327-TW) with NT$5,080.

Among the top 10 net sellers by institutional investors, six were financial stocks, with United Microelectronics (2303-TW) ranking first with NT$6,458, Fubon Financial (2881-TW) with NT$3,184, Evergreen Financial (2880-TW) with NT$1,879, Meta Gold (1055-TW) with NT$1,821, Shanghai Commercial Bank (1182-TW) with NT$1,395, and Taiwan New Century Financial (2882-TW) with NT$1,311.

Investors noted that the short-term trend of the Taiwan Stock Exchange continues to be dominated by value stocks and theme stocks, with the index falling below its seasonally adjusted average and then recovering. Fortunately, the closing price was still above all moving averages. Observers are watching the 4,400-point level as a potential support level, while the resistance level of 44,600-45,000 points is still in place. For the index to continue to strengthen, it is necessary to observe whether Powerchip and United Microelectronics can stabilize, as well as the continuation of the strong performance of the over-the-counter market.

Investors pointed out that tonight's US initial jobless claims and Friday's (August 7) non-farm payrolls will continue to test the ADP employment data, and before the data is released, it is necessary to pay attention to the risk of high volatility.

items.title: 廣越Q2轉盈EPS2.55元 下半年迎出貨旺季
items.title_en: Fuyuan Q2 Turns Profit EPS2.55 Per Share
paras: 戶外機能服飾與羽絨衣代工廠廣越 (4438-TW) 今 (6) 日公告第二季財報，稅後純益 2.87 億元；每股純益 2.55 元，較上季及去年同期虧轉盈，上半年稅後純益 2.82 億元、每股純益 2.51 元，同樣較去年同期虧轉盈。
廣越董事長吳朝筆表示，隨下半年進入傳統生產與出貨旺季，將持續掌握出貨節奏，並透過高端機能服飾製造能力、跨區域產能調度及穩定交付品質，深化與國際品牌客戶的長期合作關係。
此外，雖外部環境變化迅速，廣越持續透過提升營運效率、強化成本控管及優化產能配置，以改善獲利結構並提升長期營運韌性，2026 年全年每股純益力拚回到 2023 年水準，並目標維持約 70% 的現金股利配發率。
廣越第二季營收 51.63 億元，年增 7.5%、毛利率 14.4%，年減 2.2 個百分點、營業利益率 5.3%，年減 2.4 個百分點；上半年營收 79.4 億元，年增 5%，毛利率 13.5%、年減 0.9 個百分點、營業利益率 11.2%，年減 0.2 個百分點。
廣越表示，上半年受惠於處分不動產、認列越南工廠火災保險理賠收益，以及匯率波動較去年同期趨穩下，業外由去年同期淨損失 4 億元轉為淨收益 2.67 億元，帶動整體獲利轉盈。
paras_en: Fuyuan (4438-TW) announced its second-quarter earnings report today, with a net profit of NT$2.87 billion; EPS of NT$2.55, a turnaround from a loss in the same period last year. In the first half of the year, the company's net profit was NT$2.82 billion, with EPS of NT$2.51, also a turnaround from a loss in the same period last year.

Fuyuan Chairman Wu Chou-pen said that as the second half of the year enters the traditional production and sales peak season, the company will continue to control its sales pace and deepen its long-term cooperation with international brand customers through its high-end functional clothing manufacturing capabilities, cross-regional production capacity adjustment, and stable delivery quality.

Despite rapid changes in the external environment, Fuyuan has continued to improve its operating efficiency, strengthen cost control, and optimize its production capacity to improve its profitability structure and enhance its long-term operating resilience. The company aims to return to its 2023 EPS level by the end of 2026 and maintain a cash dividend payout ratio of around 70%.

Fuyuan's second-quarter revenue was NT$51.63 billion, up 7.5% year-over-year, with a gross margin of 14.4%, down 2.2 percentage points year-over-year, and an operating profit margin of 5.3%, down 2.4 percentage points year-over-year. In the first half of the year, revenue was NT$79.4 billion, up 5% year-over-year, with a gross margin of 13.5%, down 0.9 percentage points year-over-year, and an operating profit margin of 11.2%, down 0.2 percentage points year-over-year.

Fuyuan said that in the first half of the year, it benefited from the disposal of non-current assets, the recognition of insurance claims for the Vietnam factory fire, and the stabilization of exchange rate fluctuations compared to the same period last year, resulting in a net gain of NT$2.67 billion, a turnaround from a net loss of NT$4 billion in the same period last year, which drove the company's overall profitability turnaround.

items.title: 早期股東要套現了！SpaceX逾9億股解禁 股價恐再承壓
items.title_en: Early Shareholders Set to Cash Out! Over 910 Million SpaceX Shares Unlock, Stock May Face Further Pressure
paras: SpaceX (SPCX-US) 上市後首批股票禁售期周四 (6 日) 屆滿，早期投資人將首度有機會出售部分持股。此次共有逾 9.11 億股取得交易資格，約占流通在外股份的 7%，規模甚至超過該公司首次公開募股 (IPO) 時發行的 6.39 億股，可能使已較 6 月中高點回落逾 50% 的股價承受進一步賣壓。
馬斯克旗下這家可重複使用火箭製造商 6 月登上那斯達克時，股價迅速升至 150 美元，數日後更突破 225 美元。不過，上市後 8 周走勢劇烈震盪，周三收在 108.27 美元低點。SpaceX 周二盤後公布上市以來首份財報，揭露資本支出超過營收兩倍，股價隨即重挫。
Rainmaker Securities 共同創辦人馬丁 (Greg Martin) 表示，相較於公司基本面或策略，禁售期解除可能更直接左右 SpaceX 股價短期走勢。
而且，後續還有更多股票可能陸續解禁。根據招股書，8 月 20 日另有 3.19 億股可能解除限制，9 月預計再釋出約 7 億股，10 月解禁規模也接近 7 億股，市場流通籌碼將持續增加。
不過，瑞穗分析師提醒，雖然潛在供給增幅相當可觀，但股票取得出售資格，並不代表整批持股都會立即流入市場。
馬斯克是 SpaceX 最大股東，持有超過 60 億股，但其持股禁售期要到 2027 年 6 月才會屆滿，因此不在本輪解禁範圍內。
亞特蘭大獵鷹隊安全衛貝茲 (Jessie Bates III) 則是準備套現的早期投資人之一。他 2022 年在 SpaceX 估值 1,270 億美元時投入約 15 萬美元；公司目前估值已達 1.43 兆美元，使其持股價值可能超過 150 萬美元。貝茲表示，計劃出售全部持股以鎖定獲利。
SpaceX 今年 2 月與馬斯克旗下 xAI 合併，合併後估值達 1.25 兆美元；上市前又同意以 600 億美元收購 AI 程式設計公司 Cursor，交易預計本季完成。市場除關注公司透過併購拓展成長機會，也將密切觀察首批解禁股票實際出售規模，是否加劇 SpaceX 上市後的股價跌勢。
paras_en: SpaceX (SPCX-US) saw its first batch of lock‑up shares expire on Thursday (the 6th), giving early investors their first chance to sell a portion of their holdings. More than 911 million shares are now eligible to trade, about 7% of the float, a volume that even exceeds the 639 million shares issued in the company’s IPO and could add further selling pressure to a stock that has already fallen more than 50% from its mid‑June peak.

When Musk’s reusable‑rocket maker debuted on Nasdaq in June, the share price quickly rose to $150 and a few days later broke $225. However, after eight weeks of volatile trading, it closed Wednesday at a low of $108.27. SpaceX posted its first earnings report after the listing on Tuesday after‑hours, revealing capital expenditures more than twice its revenue, which sent the stock sharply lower.
Greg Martin, co‑founder of Rainmaker Securities, said that the lock‑up expiration may have a more direct impact on SpaceX’s short‑term price movement than the company’s fundamentals or strategy.

Moreover, more shares are expected to unlock later. According to the prospectus, another 319 million shares could be released on August 20, about 700 million are slated for September, and the October unlock will be close to 700 million as well, continuously increasing the market float.
Mizuho analysts cautioned that while the potential supply increase is sizable, the fact that shares become eligible for sale does not mean the entire block will immediately hit the market.
Musk is SpaceX’s largest shareholder, holding over 6 billion shares, but his lock‑up does not expire until June 2027, so his holdings are not part of this round of unlocks.

Atlanta Falcons safety Jessie Bates III is one of the early investors preparing to cash out. He invested about $150,000 in 2022 when SpaceX was valued at $127 billion; the company is now valued at $1.43 trillion, making his stake potentially worth over $1.5 million. Bates said he plans to sell all his shares to lock in profits.

SpaceX merged with Musk’s xAI in February, bringing the combined valuation to $1.25 trillion; before the listing it also agreed to acquire AI‑coding firm Cursor for $60 billion, a deal expected to close this quarter. The market is watching not only how the merger expands growth opportunities but also the actual scale of the first unlock sales, to see if they will accelerate the post‑IPO price decline.

items.title: 說好讓Fed完全獨立！川普卻傳多次打電話給華許
items.title_en: Trump Has Been Calling Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh Despite Promising Independence
paras: 《彭博》周四 (6 日) 援引知情人士消息報導，美國總統川普自華許 (Kevin Warsh)5 月獲確認出任聯準會(Fed) 主席以來，已不定期與他多次通電話，成為川普試圖對央行發揮更大影響力的最新跡象。
其中一名知情人士表示，川普曾在通話中詢問華許對經濟的預測與看法，但未要求他採取特定行動。另有消息人士形容兩人並非定期聯絡，通話頻率也不高，目前尚不清楚雙方是否曾直接討論貨幣政策。相關通話最早由《華爾街日報》披露。
白宮發言人德賽 (Kush Desai) 表示，川普已多次強調，他會給予華許所需空間，以恢復外界對 Fed 決策能力的信心。川普雖有權表達對央行的看法，但也一再重申華許與 Fed 的獨立性。Fed 則拒絕置評。
過去美國總統與 Fed 主席也曾通話或會面，但情況相對少見。川普長期要求 Fed 大幅降息，其介入貨幣政策的程度，被視為數十年來白宮對央行最強力的施壓行動。不過，自華許上任後，川普對 Fed 的態度已較過去溫和。
華許上月在國會作證時表示，川普並未試圖干預央行，但他迴避直接回答上任後是否曾與川普通話。華許表示，不願公開自己與總統之間的談話內容，但承諾會維持獨立，且接到總統或參議院銀行委員會主席的電話並不會讓他感到不自在。
相較之下，前 Fed 主席鮑爾 2025 年 5 月與川普會面後，曾發布聲明向外界說明，並強調雙方未討論其貨幣政策展望。華許目前也定期與財政部長貝森特會面，延續 Fed 與財政部高層長期互動的慣例。
川普過去多次批評鮑爾降息「太慢」，其政府還針對 Fed 總部翻修工程對鮑爾展開調查。川普也曾試圖解職 Fed 理事庫克 (Lisa Cook)，但未能成功，據傳還考慮對理事巴爾(Michael Barr) 採取類似行動。
然而，川普公開對待華許的方式明顯不同。他在華許宣誓就職時表示，希望 Fed 主席「完全獨立」，並要他不要看任何人的臉色，只需按照自己的判斷做好工作。華許上任後決定維持利率不變，川普也未直接責怪他，而是將結果歸咎於一個被他批評為「非常政治化」的 Fed 理事會。
不過，川普持續對央行施壓，仍使 Fed 與行政部門之間的界線變得模糊，並可能影響市場對央行獨立性的信心。Fed 目前還須因應美伊戰爭造成的能源價格波動、川普反覆調整的關稅政策、揮之不去的通膨，以及龐大的美國預算赤字。
《華爾街日報》(WSJ) 指出，川普曾向華許詢問美伊戰爭對經濟的衝擊及 AI 崛起等議題，華許通常向川普描繪相對正面的經濟前景，但兩人是否談及利率政策仍不得而知。
paras_en: According to a Bloomberg report on Thursday, citing people familiar with the matter, US President Trump has been making periodic phone calls to Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh since his confirmation in May, in a sign of Trump's attempt to exert greater influence over the central bank.

One of the sources said that Trump had asked Warsh about his economic forecasts and views during the calls, but did not request him to take specific actions. Another source described the calls as not being on a regular basis and not frequent, and it is unclear whether the two have directly discussed monetary policy. The calls were first reported by The Wall Street Journal.

White House spokesman Kush Desai stated that Trump has repeatedly emphasized that he will give Warsh the space needed to restore confidence in the Fed's decision-making ability. Although Trump has the right to express his views on the central bank, he has also repeatedly reaffirmed Warsh's and the Fed's independence. The Fed declined to comment.

In the past, US presidents and Fed chairmen have also made phone calls or met, but such instances are relatively rare. Trump has long been pushing for the Fed to cut interest rates sharply, and his intervention in monetary policy is seen as the strongest pressure on the central bank from the White House in decades. However, since Warsh took office, Trump's attitude towards the Fed has been more moderate than in the past.

Warsh testified before Congress last month that Trump had not tried to interfere with the central bank, but he avoided directly answering whether he had spoken with Trump since taking office. Warsh stated that he did not want to disclose the content of his conversations with the president, but promised to maintain independence and would not feel uncomfortable receiving calls from the president or the chairman of the Senate Banking Committee.

In comparison, former Fed Chairman Powell issued a statement after meeting with Trump in May 2025, explaining the situation and emphasizing that they did not discuss monetary policy outlook. Warsh is also meeting regularly with Treasury Secretary Yellen, continuing the long-standing practice of interaction between the Fed and senior Treasury officials.

Trump has previously criticized Powell for cutting interest rates too slowly, and his administration even launched an investigation into the Fed's headquarters renovation project. Trump also tried to fire Fed Governor Lisa Cook but was unsuccessful, and reportedly considered taking similar action against Governor Michael Barr.

However, Trump's public treatment of Warsh has been noticeably different. When Warsh was sworn in, Trump stated that he hoped the Fed chairman would be 'completely independent' and told him to make decisions based on his own judgment, without considering anyone else's opinions. After Warsh decided to keep interest rates unchanged, Trump did not directly blame him, instead attributing the result to a Fed board that he criticized as 'very political'.

Nevertheless, Trump's continued pressure on the central bank has blurred the line between the Fed and the executive branch, potentially affecting market confidence in the central bank's independence. The Fed is currently facing challenges such as energy price fluctuations caused by the US-Iran war, Trump's fluctuating tariff policies, persistent inflation, and a large US budget deficit.

The Wall Street Journal reported that Trump had asked Warsh about the economic impact of the US-Iran war and the rise of AI, among other topics. Warsh typically presented a relatively positive economic outlook to Trump, but it is unclear whether the two discussed interest rate policies.

items.title: 〈美股早盤〉科技股走弱、油價推升殖利率 主要指數漲跌互見
paras: 美股主要指數周四 (6 日) 開盤漲跌互見，科技股賣壓拖累大盤，加上油價走高加劇通膨疑慮並推升美債殖利率，投資人在周五 (7 日) 關鍵非農就業報告出爐前轉趨謹慎。道瓊工業指數開盤走高，標普 500 指數在平盤附近震盪，那斯達克指數則開低。
威騰電子 (WDC-US) 與 SanDisk (SNDK-US) 雖繳出強勁財報及展望，仍未能滿足市場先前墊高的期待，股價雙雙重挫，進一步壓抑科技與記憶體類股。
市場同時密切關注中東局勢，伊朗與阿曼正推動重啟荷姆茲海峽航運的協議，但美伊能否達成更全面且持久的和平協議仍充滿不確定性。除地緣政治發展外，華爾街也正消化新一波企業財報，並等待就業數據提供 Fed 後續利率路徑的線索。
截稿前，道瓊工業指數漲近 260 點或近 0.5%，那斯達克綜合指數跌 220 點或 近 0.8%，標普 500 指數跌近 0.2%，費城半導體指數跌 1.4%。台積電 ADR 跌近 0.8%。
美股主要指數期貨周四漲跌互見，科技股走弱壓抑市場表現，投資人一方面等待美伊談判進展，另一方面觀望周五公布的美國非農就業報告，以尋找 Fed 未來利率政策的線索。
標普 500 指數期貨小漲 0.1%，那斯達克 100 指數期貨下跌 0.6%。記憶體大廠 SanDisk (SNDK-US) 與威騰電子 (WDC-US) 公布財報後，盤前分別重挫 9% 及 15%，儘管兩家公司業績與財測表現強勁，仍未能滿足市場先前墊高的期待。
Google 母公司 Alphabet (GOOGL-US) 由漲轉跌。該公司開始推銷最新一筆美國投資等級債券，外傳籌資規模最高可達 250 億美元。Alphabet 日前將 2026 年支出預測上調至最多 2,050 億美元，已引發投資人對 AI 巨額投入能否帶來足夠回報的疑慮，這次發債也將測試市場經歷 7 月 AI 債券拋售後的認購意願。
市場同時關注價值約 1,010 億美元的 SpaceX(SPCX-US) 股票周四解除交易限制。SpaceX 公布上市後首份季度財報後，股價一度重挫 14%，周四盤前則有所回升。
隨著科技股漲勢暫歇，投資人正重新評估 AI 概念股估值。周五非農就業報告預計將顯示美國勞動市場轉強，若數據高於預期，可能升高 Fed 升息預期；若數據疲弱，交易員則可能下修緊縮押注，減輕美債殖利率的上行壓力。
SEB 分析主管史坦納 (Karl Steiner) 表示，在中東局勢出現更明確的正面進展，以及美國重要就業數據公布前，市場目前採取觀望態度。《彭博》策略師孔寧 (Skylar Montgomery Koning) 指出，這份就業報告可能帶來兩極化反應，若連續第二次疲弱，將強化鴿派論點；若數據強勁，則意味 6 月表現可能只是異常，並使市場提前升息預期。
商品市場方面，布蘭特原油維持在每桶 80 美元附近。伊朗表示，已與阿曼就荷姆茲海峽航線提案達成協議，提高這條關鍵水道恢復能源運輸的可能性。不過，美伊仍未達成可持續緩解通膨與美債殖利率壓力的協議，美國總統川普周三僅表示，將觀察談判後續發展。
美元延續前一交易日跌勢，美國公債價格下滑，10 年期美債殖利率上升 3 個基點至 4.64%。黃金一度上漲 1.4%，短暫突破每盎司 4,300 美元。
歐股方面，道瓊歐洲 600 指數上漲 0.4%。德國電信宣布擴大庫藏股計畫後大漲 6.7%，英國酒商帝亞吉歐預測業務將恢復成長，股價上漲 7%；西門子因上調展望幅度未能滿足投資人期待，下跌 4.6%。
亞洲半導體股也成為賣壓重心，被視為 AI 交易風向球的南韓 Kospi 指數重挫 4.6%，SK 海力士與三星電子領跌。

items.title: 蘋果緊急搶購DRAM 距iPhone 18發表僅剩幾周
items.title_en: Apple Rushes to Secure DRAM Supply Ahead of iPhone 18 Launch
paras: 蘋果 (AAPL-US) 新機發表在即，記憶體供應鏈緊張局面進一步升級，知名分析師高燦鳴（Tim Culpan）5 日爆料，蘋果和供應商正在緊急搶購記憶體晶片。
距離備受期待的折疊 iPhone Ultra 以及 iPhone 18 和 iPhone 18 Pro 預計亮相的時間不到六周，蘋果組裝供應鏈正加快協調 DRAM。
目前蘋果高度美光供應 DRAM，但也向 SK 海力士和三星採購。但隨著 AI 資料中心需求持續擠佔記憶體資源，全球 DRAM 供應趨緊，蘋果也開始面臨過去較少遇到的供應壓力。
據韓國媒體《Digital Daily》5 日報導，蘋果曾試圖與長鑫存儲商談更低 DRAM 採購價格，但遭到拒絕。長鑫存儲堅持要求報價不低於三星電子和 SK 海力士，甚至更高。
原因在於，華為、小米等中國本土企業已透過長期合約鎖定長鑫存儲產能，因此長鑫存儲無需遷就蘋果的苛刻條件。
蘋果今年旗艦 iPhone 預計搭載首款採用台積電 N2 製程量產的 A20 Pro 晶片。
目前 A20 Pro 晶圓製造進展順利，良率表現也較為理想。但供應鏈消息顯示，大量已經完成製造的晶圓正在等待配套 DRAM 到位，無法順利進入後續封裝，封裝產能因此成為新機量產的關鍵限制因素。
高燦鳴指出，目前影響蘋果新機生產的核心問題，並非台積電先進製程產能不足，而是記憶體供應與先進封裝之間出現銜接壓力。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) is about to launch its new devices, and the memory supply chain is facing increased tension. Noted analyst Tim Culpan revealed on the 5th that Apple and its suppliers are urgently purchasing memory chips.

With less than six weeks to go before the highly anticipated foldable iPhone Ultra, iPhone 18, and iPhone 18 Pro are expected to debut, Apple's assembly supply chain is accelerating coordination for DRAM.

Currently, Apple primarily sources DRAM from Micron, but also purchases from SK Hynix and Samsung. However, as AI data center demand continues to occupy memory resources, the global DRAM supply is tightening, and Apple is facing supply pressure that it has rarely encountered in the past.

According to a report by Korean media outlet Digital Daily on the 5th, Apple attempted to negotiate a lower DRAM purchase price with CXMT, but was rejected. CXMT insisted on a quote that was not lower than Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix, and even higher.

The reason is that Chinese companies such as Huawei and Xiaomi have already locked in CXMT's production capacity through long-term contracts, so CXMT does not need to accommodate Apple's stringent conditions.
This year, Apple's flagship iPhone is expected to be equipped with the first A20 Pro chip produced using TSMC's N2 process.

Currently, the production of the A20 Pro wafer is proceeding smoothly, and the yield is relatively ideal. However, supply chain news indicates that a large number of wafers that have already been manufactured are waiting for matching DRAM to be in place and cannot proceed to the next packaging stage, making packaging capacity a key limiting factor for mass production of new devices.

Tim Culpan pointed out that the core issue currently affecting Apple's new device production is not the insufficient production capacity of TSMC's advanced process, but the connection pressure between memory supply and advanced packaging.

items.title: AI到底多燒錢？Google母公司Alphabet擬再發債最多250億美元
items.title_en: How Much Does AI Burn Money? Alphabet Plans to Issue Up to $25 Billion in Debt
paras: Google 母公司 Alphabet(GOOGL-US) 計劃透過最新一筆美國投資等級債券發行案，籌集最多 250 億美元資金。這筆交易將測試 AI 相關債券經歷 7 月拋售後，投資人的認購意願是否已經回溫。
外媒周四 (6 日) 援引知情人士消息報導，Alphabet 尚未對最終發行規模作出決定。此次債券最多分為 10 個券次，期限從 2 年至 40 年不等，其中最長天期債券的初步定價討論，殖利率較同年期美國公債高約 1.55 個百分點。
Alphabet 兩周前大幅上調 2026 年支出展望，再度引發市場質疑，科技巨頭投入 AI 的龐大資金最終能否轉化為相應報酬。該公司將 2026 年支出預測提高至最多 2,050 億美元，規模較 2025 年增加逾 1 倍，也使投資人對協助科技公司支應 AI 支出的債券需求在 7 月明顯降溫。
近期幾筆交易已顯示市場態度轉趨謹慎。與貝萊德 (BLK-US) 有關的公司上周發行 125 億美元債券，資金連結 Meta(META-US) 位於德州的資料中心計畫，但初期需求表現低迷；亞馬遜先前的發債案認購意願同樣疲弱。包括 SpaceX 在內的企業新發行 AI 相關債券，在次級市場的利差也持續擴大。
Alphabet 與亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 是本輪 AI 基礎設施舉債潮的主要推動者。Alphabet 在 2026 年上半年已發行超過 500 億美元債務，上一次進入美國高評級債券市場是在 2 月，此後陸續發行瑞士法郎、英鎊、歐元、加幣及日圓計價債券，兩個月前還發行近 850 億美元股票。
巨額資本支出已對 Alphabet 現金流造成壓力，使公司出現自 2004 年首次公開募股 (IPO) 以來，首度單季自由現金流轉負。此次最多 250 億美元的發債案，除了反映 Alphabet 持續投入 AI 基礎建設的龐大資金需求，也將成為市場檢驗投資人是否仍願意為科技巨頭 AI 擴張買單的重要指標。
paras_en: Alphabet, the parent company of Google (GOOGL-US), plans to issue up to $25 billion in debt through its latest investment-grade bond issuance, raising the most funds in the company's history. This transaction will test whether investors' appetite for AI-related bonds has recovered after a 7% decline in July.

According to sources, Alphabet has not yet made a decision on the final issuance size. This bond issue will be divided into up to 10 tranches, with maturities ranging from 2 to 40 years, including a preliminary discussion on the pricing of the longest-dated bond, which is expected to yield around 1.55% more than comparable US Treasuries.

Alphabet increased its 2026 expenditure forecast by a significant margin two weeks ago, sparking concerns about whether the massive investment in AI will ultimately generate corresponding returns. The company has raised its 2026 expenditure forecast to up to $205 billion, a more than 10-fold increase from 2025, which has led to a significant decline in demand for bonds that help finance AI expenditures in July.

Recent transactions have shown a cautious market attitude. A company related to BlackRock (BLK-US) issued $125 billion in bonds last week, linked to Meta's (META-US) data center project in Texas, but initial demand was sluggish; Amazon's (AMZN-US) previous debt issuance also saw weak demand. The spread of AI-related bonds in the secondary market has continued to widen, including those issued by SpaceX.

Alphabet and Amazon are the main drivers of the current AI infrastructure debt wave. Alphabet has already issued over $500 billion in debt in the first half of 2026, with its last entry into the US high-grade bond market in February, followed by the issuance of Swiss franc, pound, euro, Canadian dollar, and yen-denominated bonds. Two months ago, the company also issued nearly $850 billion in stock.

The massive capital expenditures have put pressure on Alphabet's cash flow, making it the first time since its initial public offering (IPO) in 2004 that the company has reported a negative free cash flow in a single quarter. The upcoming debt issuance of up to $25 billion will serve as an important indicator of whether investors are still willing to buy into the AI expansion of tech giants.

items.title: 飛機增產帶動零件需求Howmet Aerospace上調2026年財測
items.title_en: Aircraft Production Surge Drives Parts Demand, Howmet Aerospace Raises 2026 Outlook
paras: 2026年08月06日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 美國航太零組件製造商Howmet Aerospace(HWM-US)受惠於波音Boeing(BA-US)與空中巴士Airbus持續提高飛機產量，加上AI資料中心帶動燃氣渦輪機葉片需求增加，宣布上調2026年全年營收與獲利財測，盤前股價上漲3%。
公司預估，2026年調整後每股盈餘將介於5.23美元至5.31美元，高於先前預估的4.88美元至5.00美元；全年營收預估也由95.8億美元至97.3億美元，上調至100億美元至101億美元。
Howmet Aerospace表示，除了商用航空市場持續成長，地緣政治緊張也帶動國防需求增加，公司正評估擴建產能，以因應更多訂單。今年以來，公司股價已上漲逾40%。
第二季調整後每股盈餘為1.33美元，年增率46%，優於市場預估的1.25美元；營收25.5億美元，年增率24%，同樣高於市場預估的24.3億美元。
雖然航太供應鏈已逐漸改善，但座椅、發動機、機窗等部分零件仍供應不足，加上需求持續增加，使零組件價格維持高檔。
其中，緊固件（如螺絲、螺帽、鉚釘等飛機固定零件）因供應商數量大幅減少，價格持續上漲。據兩位知情人士透露，Howmet Aerospace近幾個月已將部分緊固件售價調高一倍。
航太顧問公司AlixPartners合夥人暨董事總經理Matteo Peraldo表示，飛機製造商如今開始更加重視零件成本，其中緊固件已成為降低採購成本的重點項目。

paras_en: August 6, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center) – U.S. aerospace components maker Howmet Aerospace (HWM‑US) said it is raising its full‑year 2026 revenue and profit forecasts after benefiting from Boeing (BA‑US) and Airbus continuously increasing aircraft output, and from AI data‑center growth spurring higher demand for gas‑turbine blades. The stock was up about 3% in pre‑market trading.

The company now expects adjusted earnings per share for 2026 to be between $5.23 and $5.31, up from the prior range of $4.88 to $5.00, and it lifts its full‑year revenue outlook from $9.58‑$9.73 billion to $10.0‑$10.1 billion.

Howmet Aerospace said that, in addition to the continued growth of the commercial aviation market, heightened geopolitical tensions are boosting defense demand, and the company is evaluating capacity expansions to meet the larger order flow. Its share price has risen more than 40% so far this year.

Adjusted earnings per share for the second quarter were $1.33, a 46% year‑over‑year increase, beating the market estimate of $1.25. Revenue came in at $2.55 billion, up 24% year‑over‑year, also above the consensus estimate of $2.43 billion.
Although the aerospace supply chain is gradually improving, parts such as seats, engines and windows remain in short supply, and continued demand growth keeps component prices at elevated levels.

Fasteners – such as screws, nuts, rivets and other aircraft‑fixing parts – have seen prices keep climbing as the number of suppliers has sharply declined. Two informed sources said Howmet Aerospace has raised prices on some fasteners by as much as 100% in recent months.

items.title: 華爾街的代幣化熱潮引發風險辯論
items.title_en: Wall Street's Tokenization Boom Sparks Risk Debate
paras: 在傳統的股票交易背後，存在著一個由經紀商、清算所和託管機構組成的複雜中介鏈條，大多數投資者平時鮮少察覺其運作。然而，隨著區塊鏈技術的成熟，金融界正掀起一場「代幣化」(Tokenization) 革命，試圖將股票、債券等資產轉化為在數位帳本上運行的代幣。

市場規模迅速擴張

代幣化已不再是加密貨幣領域的專利，華爾街頂尖金融機構正積極布局，以確保在技術變革中占有一席之地。摩根大通、花旗集團、紐約梅隆銀行 (BNY Mellon) 以及紐約證券交易所 (NYSE) 等機構皆已啟動相關研究專案。
此外，美國最重要的清算機構——存管信託及結算公司 (DTCC) 已於 7 月中旬完成一項試點計畫，成功將股票、國債和交易所買賣基金 (ETF) 轉化為數位代幣。
根據數據追蹤機構 RWA.xyz 的統計，代幣化傳統資產的市值自 2025 年 8 月以來已翻倍，達到約 370 億美元。雖然與全球數兆美元的證券市場相比仍屬微小，但其成長勢頭已引起監管機構對市場穩定性的高度關注。

運作模式與潛在優勢 

代幣化證券本質上是數位化的產權證明，其交易在區塊鏈上公開透明且易於驗證。
美國證券交易委員會 (SEC) 指出，代幣化可透過三種主要形式存在：第一是公司直接發行代幣化股票或債券；第二是由第三方機構持有原始資產，並發行代表間接所有權的代幣；第三則是發行僅代表資產經濟價值的合約型代幣，類似於現有的衍生品。
支持者認為，代幣化能顯著提升金融效率，包括實現 24/7 全天候交易、降低投資成本，以及讓小額投資者更容易進行碎股交易。此外，代幣還可以透過代碼嵌入交易規則，實現自動化執行。

監管隱憂與市場韌性的挑戰 

然而，這項技術也伴隨著風險。國際貨幣基金 (IMF) 警告，代幣化可能會加速金融危機的傳播。現行體系中的「結算延遲」和「固定交易時間」實際上為監管機構提供了干預危機的緩衝期，而區塊鏈的即時性可能取消這種保護機制。
此外，在傳統市場休市期間 (如周末或深夜) 進行代幣交易，可能會因流動性不足而引發價格劇烈波動。
paras_en: Behind traditional stock trading lies a complex chain of intermediaries—brokers, clearing houses, and custodians—that most investors rarely notice in their day‑to‑day activities. Yet, as blockchain technology matures, the financial world is launching a “tokenization” revolution, aiming to turn stocks, bonds and other assets into tokens that run on a digital ledger.

The market is expanding rapidly. Tokenization is no longer the exclusive domain of the crypto space; top Wall Street firms are actively positioning themselves to secure a foothold in this technological shift. JPMorgan Chase, Citigroup, BNY Mellon and the New York Stock Exchange have all launched related research projects.

Moreover, the United States’ most important clearing organization—the Depository Trust & Clearing Corporation (DTCC)—completed a pilot in mid‑July that successfully converted stocks, Treasury bonds and exchange‑traded funds (ETFs) into digital tokens.

According to data‑tracking firm RWA.xyz, the market value of tokenized traditional assets has doubled since August 2025, reaching roughly $37 billion. Although still tiny compared with the multi‑trillion‑dollar global securities market, its growth trajectory has drawn heightened regulatory attention to market stability.

Operating Model and Potential Benefits
Tokenized securities are essentially digital proof of ownership, with trades conducted on a blockchain that is public, transparent and easy to verify.

The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) notes that tokenization can take three main forms: first, a company directly issues tokenized shares or bonds; second, a third‑party holds the underlying asset and issues tokens representing indirect ownership; third, contracts that represent only the economic value of the asset are issued, akin to existing derivatives.

Proponents argue that tokenization can markedly improve financial efficiency, enabling 24/7 trading, lowering investment costs, and making fractional share purchases more accessible to small investors. Tokens can also embed trading rules in code, allowing for automated execution.

Regulatory Concerns and Market Resilience Challenges
However, the technology also carries risks. The International Monetary Fund (IMF) warns that tokenization could accelerate the spread of financial crises. In the current system, “settlement delays” and “fixed trading hours” provide regulators with a buffer to intervene during turmoil, a protection that blockchain’s immediacy might eliminate.
Furthermore, trading tokens during traditional market closures—such as weekends or overnight—could lead to severe price volatility due to insufficient liquidity.

items.title: 英國點頭了！派拉蒙1100億美元吞華納兄弟探索再過一關
items.title_en: UK Approves! Paramount's $110 Billion Acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery Clears Another Hurdle
paras: 派拉蒙天舞 (Paramount Skydance)(PSKY-US) 斥資 1,100 億美元收購華納兄弟探索 (Warner Bros. Discovery)(WBD-US) 的交易，儘管目前因美國法律挑戰陷入停擺，但周四 (6 日) 在英國監管審查方面取得進展。英國反壟斷主管機關與文化大臣均決定不再升級調查，為這項大型媒體併購案掃除一道障礙。
英國競爭與市場管理局 (CMA) 表示，這項交易不會在英國引發競爭疑慮，因此決定不將其提交更深入的第二階段調查。英國文化、媒體暨體育大臣南迪 (Lisa Nandy) 也在派拉蒙提出保證與具法律約束力的承諾後，決定不介入交易。
CMA 在聲明中指出，現有證據顯示，兩家公司合併後，派拉蒙在各項業務領域仍將面臨充分競爭，包括電影與電視內容的製作及發行、向付費電視業者提供兒童頻道，以及串流服務市場，因此無須進一步審查。
英國監管機關放行後，派拉蒙可將重心轉向美國面臨的法律挑戰。由美國 12 州及美國編劇工會 (Writers Guild of America) 提出的訴訟，已迫使派拉蒙暫停推進交易。反對者對兩家大型好萊塢片廠、兩個串流平台及兩家大型有線電視頻道營運商合併可能造成的市場影響表達疑慮。
這項交易若順利完成，將重塑全球影視娛樂產業版圖，並讓派拉蒙與華納兄弟探索旗下龐大的電影、電視、串流及有線電視資產整合至同一集團。
歐盟上月已對這起併購案給予有條件批准，如今英國也決定放行，意味交易在歐洲主要監管市場取得重要進展。不過，在美國反對聲浪持續升高、法律程序尚未解決之際，這宗 1,100 億美元的好萊塢巨型併購案能否重新啟動，仍存在高度不確定性。
paras_en: Paramount Skydance (PSKY-US) has committed $110 billion to acquire Warner Bros. Discovery (WBD-US), despite being stalled due to US legal challenges. However, the company made progress in the UK regulatory review on Thursday (6th). The UK's antitrust authority and the culture secretary have decided not to escalate the investigation, clearing a major hurdle for the massive media merger.

The UK's Competition and Markets Authority (CMA) stated that this transaction will not raise competition concerns in the UK and has decided not to submit it for further review in the second stage. UK Culture Secretary Lisa Nandy also decided not to intervene in the transaction after Paramount made guarantees and legally binding commitments.

The CMA stated in a statement that existing evidence shows that Paramount will still face sufficient competition in various business areas after the merger, including film and television content production and distribution, provision of children's channels to pay-TV operators, and streaming services, therefore no further review is required.

After the UK regulatory clearance, Paramount can focus on the US legal challenges. The lawsuit filed by 12 US states and the Writers Guild of America has forced Paramount to pause the transaction. Opponents have expressed concerns about the potential market impact of the merger between two major Hollywood film studios, two streaming platforms, and two major cable television operators.

If the transaction is completed, it will reshape the global entertainment industry landscape and integrate Paramount's and Warner Bros. Discovery's massive film, television, streaming, and cable television assets into a single group.

The EU has already given conditional approval to this merger last month, and now the UK has also decided to clear the transaction, meaning that the deal has made significant progress in major regulatory markets in Europe. However, with the US opposition continuing to rise and the legal process still unresolved, it remains highly uncertain whether this $110 billion Hollywood giant merger can be reactivated.

paras_en: Foreign investors made a large net purchase of Taiwanese stocks yesterday (the 5th) and continued net buying today (the 6th), prompting the New Taiwan dollar to briefly rise more than 0.1 NTD against the US dollar. However, importers seized the opportunity to buy foreign currency, curbing the dollar's gains. It closed at 32.261 NTD, up 0.054 NTD, a more‑than‑two‑week high, with total turnover in the Taipei and Yuan‑Tai foreign‑exchange markets reaching US$3.1385 billion.

Asian equities fell across the board today, but the Taipei market moved in the opposite direction. The main index slipped nearly 600 points, with TSMC and MediaTek ending lower, while heavyweight stocks such as Delta Electronics and Foxconn provided strong support. PCB and memory stocks also attracted buying, narrowing the index’s decline. It closed at 44,396.7 points, down 214.9 points.

The New Taiwan dollar opened at 32.29 NTD per US dollar and peaked at 32.20 NTD, marking a second consecutive day of appreciation. In the afternoon, foreign‑exchange trading cooled and buying pressure on the dollar intensified, trimming the gains. The currency settled at 32.261 NTD, up 0.054 NTD, its highest level since July 20 of this year.

paras: 美元周三 (5 日) 走弱，跌至七周低點，市場期待華府與德黑蘭朝達成和平協議邁進。同時，日元走勢震盪，但仍遠高於上周美日聯手干預匯市前創下的 40 年低點。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數 (DXY) 下跌 0.2%，報 99.68，創 6 月 16 日以來最低水準。
外匯市場焦點仍是日元。日元兌美元小幅走強，美元兌日元最新報 157.69，微幅下跌。
美國財政部長貝森特 (Scott Bessent) 本周稍早證實，美國已與日本共同進場買入日元，這是 2011 年以來雙方首次聯合干預匯市，也是美國自 1998 年以來首度直接出手支撐日元。
貝森特周二接受 CNBC 訪問時表示，美方之所以協助干預，是因為日元若持續走弱，可能對亞洲金融市場造成衝擊。
德意志銀行策略師 Jim Reid 表示，「我們的外匯策略團隊認為，日本央行 (BoJ) 必須加快升息步伐，才能讓日元出現更持久的回升。」
日本央行周三公布最新利率會議紀錄顯示，決策官員預期，中東衝突引發的油價衝擊，可能導致日本經濟成長放緩，同時推升通膨。
Reid 指出，「日本央行 6 月會議紀錄顯示，多位委員預期，本會計年度下半年消費者通膨將明顯升溫，八位委員中有兩位主張加快升息步伐。最新公布的日本薪資數據，也可能持續增加央行升息的壓力。」
經濟數據偏弱 美元續承壓
美國經濟數據也是市場焦點。根據 ADP，美國 7 月民間新增就業人數為 4.4 萬人，低於市場預估的 6.8 萬人，也較 6 月新增的 9.5 萬人放緩。
這項數據延續了周二公布的 6 月職缺數據所反映的降溫趨勢，也為周五將公布的 7 月非農就業報告提供參考。
儘管本周公布的勞動市場數據偏弱，但整體就業市場仍展現韌性，也支持聯準會 (Fed) 近期將政策重心重新放在控制通膨。
中東衝突導致油價波動，擾亂通膨走勢，也使聯準會官員對未來貨幣政策方向出現分歧。
此外，美國供應管理協會 (ISM) 公布，7 月服務業 PMI 由 6 月的 54 升至 54.1，但略低於市場預估的 54.5。其中，衡量服務業企業支付原物料及投入成本變化的物價指數較 6 月進一步攀升，且近五個月已有四次高於 70，顯示成本壓力仍高。
市場期待荷姆茲海峽協議即將達成
中東局勢方面，包括美國總統川普在內，多位美國官員表示，重新開放荷姆茲海峽 (Strait of Hormuz) 的重要協議已接近完成。
川普周二晚間向媒體表示，「事情進展得非常順利。我想 48 小時內就會知道結果。」
他並談到，「我們取得了很大進展。他們打電話給我說『拜託，我們談談吧。』他們希望展開對話。有趣的是，他們從來不提這件事…… 我認為，達成協議對他們來說會是非常明智的選擇。我們拭目以待。」
伊朗外交部則表示，德黑蘭與阿曼就荷姆茲海峽問題的談判仍在持續進行。外交部發言人 Esmaeil Baqaei 表示，只要「某些第三方」不加以阻撓，雙方聯合聲明目前已進入最終審閱與起草階段。
